fluffInfo.value: A Soulbound Host is the physical body of an apothecary who has willingly allowed an extraplanar creature to possess them, trapping the powerful outsider in a mortal form. Powerful yet vulnerable, Soulbound Hosts loathe their creators. They wander the world for the means to reverse the curse of mortality placed upon them and return to their otherworldly domains.

Exorcist and Alienist apothecaries do not primarily study the body, and rarely practice the type of magic and science which leads to mutant horrors and flesh-stitched abominations. They are instead concerned with the supernatural forces of the mind and soul. Many research and contact powerful extraplanar entities, eager to possess mortals as a means of entering the material world. These apothecaries learn how to create Soulbound Hosts as a powerful means to contain and fight back against these dangerous otherworldly foes.

fluffInfo.name: Desperate Gambit
fluffInfo.value: A Soulbound Host is usually created under truly desperate circumstances, such as when a heroic apothecary faces a dangerous otherworldly being such as a demon, fey, spirit, or inscrutable entity from the Space Between Worlds. Not only are these planar invaders pernicious foes, many are effectively immortal—often these creatures simply reform when killed outside their native planes. Thus, an apothecary who lacks the ability to defeat the demon on their own, or who wishes to defeat a powerful outsider in a more permanent fashion, may instead decide upon a heroic act of self-sacrifice by turning themselves into a Soulbound Host.

fluffInfo.name: Preparing the Trap
fluffInfo.value: Using an array of implanted metals, ingested tinctures, mental preparations, and occult incantations, a skilled apothecary may willingly prepare their body for possession. During the process, the apothecary can weave a unique spiritual trap. It then falls to the apothecary to convince the otherworldly creature to possess them, an act that many outsiders are eager to do. Thus, the canny apothecary preys on the ego of the monster itself.

fluffInfo.name: Mortal Curse
fluffInfo.value: When the outsider inhabits the body, the apothecary's soul departs, leaving the extraplanar creature to take their place spiritually. If this mortal form is killed or destroyed, the bound creature does not simply return to their plane of origin. Instead, the spirit departs to the afterworlds like any other mortal soul, losing their accumulated otherworldly power forever. Thus, the Soulbound Host becomes both a prison and a death sentence for the other wielding being tricked into the apothecary's body.

fluffInfo.name: Rogue Hosts
fluffInfo.value: Unfortunately, this act of self-sacrifice is not without its imperfections. The apothecary's body is filled with otherworldly essence, and while the creature's power is greatly diminished, they often remain extremely dangerous—allies of the departed apothecary may still find it challenging to slay the Soulbound Host. Many escape, wandering the world with stolen lives and even assuming the identity of their host while they search for the means to escape their now mortal form. All bound outsiders are painfully aware of their new mortality, frustrated that returning to their planes of origin is not a simple matter of destroying their flesh-cage or switching their essence into a different host, one which lacks the binding wards placed by the apothecary.

fluffInfo.name: Price of Freedom
fluffInfo.value: Trapped outsiders can win their freedom by calling back the soul of the apothecary who trapped them, and resurrecting them into their body. This is a thing many outsiders are loathe to do out of fiendish ego, since it puts the original soul in a bargaining position. In this way, the apothecary can force the spirit to accept a bargain which requires them to remain in their own worlds for at least the duration of the apothecary's lifetime.

fluffInfo.name: Adelaide's Secret
fluffInfo.value: In her communion with Raum, Adelaide has learned __William's__ secret—that her brother Isaac is really her half-brother. She's been manipulated into believing that her mother's infidelity and her half-brother's birth are the real causes of her fear and suffering in childhood. She was goaded by Raum into murdering Isaac, and she hid his corpse in the basement of the Old Windmill (area J1), where it is incubating a demonic servant of the Harvest Terror.

fluffInfo.value: *His mouth isn't moving but I can hear everything he's saying, I guess it's time to silence the voices.*

An Alienist seeks to master the mysteries of the mind. Having devoted years to studying the inner workings of the brain to unlock its latent potential, an Alienist is able to bend reality, read thoughts, and manipulate the thoughts of others. They tap into unfathomable realities and shift the world to their will using the psychic energies they call upon from eldritch lore and arcane knowledge.

fluffInfo.name: Alienist Minions
fluffInfo.value: Alienists keep several experiments of their own on hand. They have been known to keep __Wretched Patients__, their minds melted by the Alienist's inhuman experimentation, turning them into obedient and loyal servants. __Disembodied Psyches__ and __Cerebrografts__ are a few of their higher-end creations, having removed the brain of a creature and given it a unique and bespoke form of sentience, these creatures serve as guards to an Alienist's work, or minions capable of complex thought and aid.

entries: **Personality Trait:** I can't help but analyze every person who comes before me. I want to know what they think, and why they are the way they are.
**Bond:** I study the mind for scientific advancement. How easily this muscle can be manipulated, altered, and used in unforeseen ways is fascinating research that must be explored.
**Ideal:** I am the only one capable of this level of advanced mental research, someone else would have gotten it wrong
**Flaw:** My unbound intellect means that I can never be fooled, tricked, or manipulated, and thus I can never be outsmarted, to think I could is laughable.

actions.value: On its turn, the Amalgamation can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +17, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 36 (**4d12 + 10**) Force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature Grappled by the Amalgamation, the grapple ends and the target is swallowed. While swallowed, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover from effects originating from outside the Amalgamation, and takes 42 (**12d6**) Necrotic damage and gains a Contamination level at the start of each of the Amalgamation's turns.

If the Amalgamation takes 50+ damage in a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which land in spaces within 10 feet of the Amalgamation and have the Prone condition. If the Amalgamation dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape the corpse using 15 feet of its movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +17, reach 60 ft. *Hit:* 28 (**4d8 + 10**) Force damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 25). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition. The Amalgamation has twelve tentacles, each of which can grapple one target. Fling. One Large or smaller object held or creature Grappled by the Amalgamation is thrown up to 60 feet, landing with the Prone condition. If the target strikes a solid surface, it takes 35 (**10d6**) Force damage. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and have the Prone condition.

A Greater Restoration or __Heal__ spell ends the effect early. *Failure or Success*: 70 (**20d6**) Psychic damage.

actions.value: A Pyknic Maunder appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the Amalgamation, acting after the Amalgamation on Initiative count 20 and under the Amalgamation's direct control. The Amalgamation can have up to ten Pyknic Maunders under its control at a time.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The Amalgamation chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The Amalgamation can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

actions.name: Radiant Flame
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d10**) Radiant damage.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The dragon is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The dragon may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the dragon can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the dragon has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The dragon is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the dragon's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Haze Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the dragon takes 21 (**6d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Order Over Chaos
traits.value: Whenever the dragon is present when a roll is made on the [Arcane Anomalies](https://5e.tools/tables.html#arcane%20anomalies_monstersofdrakkenheim), Drakkenheim Madness, or [Mutations](https://5e.tools/tables.html#mutations_monstersofdrakkenheim) table, the dragon makes an additional roll on the table and chooses which result applies.

actions.name: The dragon always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the dragon can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the dragon takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bite**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +18, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 36 (**4d12 + 10**) Force damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 26). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.
**Claw**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +18, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**2d6 + 10**) Force damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 26, one creature within 20 feet of the dragon. *Failure:* 24 (**4d6 + 10**) Force damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Mindfire
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 25, one creature the dragon can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* The target takes 22 (**4d10**) Psychic damage and has the Burning condition (2d8 Psychic). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Wing Blast (1/Round)
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 25, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 20 (**3d6 + 10**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed up to 20 feet away from the dragon. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Terrifying Roar (Recharges after a Short Rest)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 25, each creature in a 120-foot Emanation originating from the dragon that can hear it. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Thunder damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Breathe Deep (1/Round)
actions.value: The dragon's Breath Weapon recharges. The dragon can only use this Epic Action if it's the first Epic Action it has taken this round. After using this Epic Action, the dragon can't use its Bite or Terrifying Roar until the start of the next round.

actions.name: Breath Weapon (Special Recharge)
actions.value: The dragon can only use this Epic Action if it's the last Epic Action it takes this round. It chooses one of the following effects:

actions.name: Octarine Breath
actions.value: The dragon breathes a 120-foot cone of prismatic rays. Each ray is a different color and has a different power and purpose. Choose one ability score, then choose Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage. Each target must succeed on a DC 25 saving throw using the chosen ability score; it takes 105 (**30d6**) damage of the chosen type on a failed saving throw, or half as much on a successful one.

actions.name: Mutation Breath
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 25, each creature in a 120-foot Cone. *Failure:* 90 (**20d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. Instead of rolling to determine if it gains a mutation, the target automatically gains a mutation. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Madness Breath
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 25, each creature in a 120-foot Cone. *Failure:* 83 (**15d10**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Dazed condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: 165 (**30d10**) Psychic damage, and the target instead has the Incapacitated condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Wild Magic Breath
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 25, each creature in a 120-foot long, 5-foot wide Line. *Failure:* 83 (**15d10**) Radiant damage, and the target triggers an [Arcane Anomalies](https://5e.tools/tables.html#arcane%20anomalies_monstersofdrakkenheim) centered on itself. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The dragon chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The dragon can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

actions.name: Contaminated Touch

While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition. The elemental can grapple one Large creature or two Medium or smaller creatures at a time.

At the start of each of the elemental's turns, the target takes 28 (**8d6**) Necrotic damage and is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level.
A creature within 5 feet of the elemental can take an action to pull a creature or object out of it with a successful DC 15 Strength (*Athletics*) check.

It attacks by first using its Creep action before it tries to Slobber on them. If threatened, it tries to cover the enemy and its territory in acidic slime. If reduced to less than half Hit Points, it attempts to flee.

traits.name: Snail Trail
traits.value: When the anomollusk moves through a space, it fills the space with contaminated mucus that remains for 10 minutes. A creature that ends its turn in the mucus is covered in goop and subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* 20 (**8d4**) Acid damage, and the target has the Slowed condition. Each time the creature ends its turn with the Slowed condition, it gains a Contamination level. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to clean away the goop, ending the Slowed condition.

actions.name: Slobber
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 20 (**8d4**) Acid damage.

actions.name: Creep
actions.value: The anomollusk moves up to its Speed, and can enter the spaces of Large or smaller creatures as it does. Each creature whose space it enters is subjected once to the following effect. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Success* The target is pushed 5 feet away from the anomollusk into a space of its choice. If the target chooses not to move, it suffers the effects of a failure. *Failure:* The target has the Prone condition and is subjected to Snail Trail.

fluffInfo.name: Perfect Transmogrification
fluffInfo.value: Amongst __Mutagenists__, the quest for genetic perfection can become an all-consuming obsession. Those who seek to achieve this so-called superior state refer to it as the "Apex" and describe the transformation as creating the ultimate humanoid specimen.

Through years of study and trials, Mutagenists have perfected their Transmogrifying Elixir to harness the ultimate power of mortal potential. This formula allows them to amplify their natural capabilities to the peak physical form while maintaining their unbound intellect. There is no telling how many long years a Mutagenist has spent in their lab, and how many unwilling test subjects had to suffer the fates of their imperfect formulae before they arrived at the ultimate conclusion of their research. This is the pinnacle of their scientific study, the perfected Transmogrifying Elixir: the Apex Formula.

fluffInfo.name: Permanent Transformation
fluffInfo.value: The process renders the Mutagenist permanently altered. Energy courses through their veins, their strength and agility extended to the very limits of human capabilities. Their form is able to shift and adapt to incoming threats, and they are able to perceive events around them with great precision. Their mind, although it remains intellectually intact by the process, is inherently and irrevocably shattered. No Mutagenist who takes the Apex Formula could ever perceive or admit to the fracturing of their mind. Regardless of their vast intelligence, a sickening madness takes hold of their psyche; one that plunges the apothecary-turned-Apex creature into a hostile, madness-filled rage. They still hold onto the threads of their vast scientific mind, using that as a justification for their actions, unaware of the deranged mental state they now reside within.

fluffInfo.name: The Folly of Perfection
fluffInfo.value: Even Mutagenists who achieve the Apex state have a gnawing question in the back of their minds: is it truly enough? Could they become even more? Their seemingly perfect form is not without subtle flaws, broken psyche, and weaknesses. Many Mutagenists can never truly be satisfied with their results, and even the Apex Formula can never fulfill the unattainable desire for absolute perfection. It is this obsession that has led many Mutagenists to lunacy in the face of their achievements. For even an Apex may spend eternity bound to their workshop, kidnapping unwilling subjects to continue to test and experiment, seeking a perfection that will never truly be achieved.

fluffInfo.name: Roleplaying Traits
fluffInfo.value: The following traits can be used to inspire roleplaying the Cacophonous Chimera:

entries: **Personality Trait:** I am humanity perfected! All beings are beneath me, for I am the apex of physical existence. All should cower in my glory
**Bond:** Science has granted us this gift! This research is the most valuable scientific discovery in the world and must be protected!
**Ideal:** Do not try and stop me, for I am offering perfection to all of humanity. Can't you see? The Apex Form will cure the world of all sickness, all flaws, all weakness!
**Flaw:** There cannot be a weakness in my design. If there is, I will solve it — I just need more time!

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine*, *Survival*, or *Arcana* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study the Apex. , learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Adapts to Threats
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Apex's Rapid Adaptation Reaction and Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Harness the Elements
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Bonus Action attacks.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Perfect Form but Fragile Mind
fluffInfo.value: You know the Apex's weakness to Necrotic and Psychic damage.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Apex will often be accompanied by several abominations of its own creation. Lab assistants, failed experiments, and __Wretched Patients__ are often by its side.

An Apex begins combat by unleashing one of its Bonus Action attacks. It quickly analyzes the battlefield, looking for the most optimal use of its energy. It observes the arrangement of its enemies and decides if it is best to use its lightning, fire, or cold attack based on what will deliver the most damage to the most targets.
It then uses its speed to move close to a target to smash it with its Slam attacks. The Apex prefers to target Frozen enemies with its Slams.

The Apex is unwilling to see its own flaws, but it is not stupid. If reduced below 60 Hit Points, it unleashes a final attack and attempts to distance itself from its enemies, hoping to escape and recuperate.

actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 27 (**4d10 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Arcane Wraiths take advantage of their Incorporeal Movement, gliding through walls and small openings, before blasting targets with Comet Shards from above. They use Nightmare Pattern to control foes and focus attacks on those unaffected by the illusion. Occasionally, they collaborate with other undead, such as Haze Husks and Haze Wights, commanding them like apprentices or minions.

While Blinded, the target has the Immobilized condition. The effect ends for the target if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to shake it out of its nightmare. When the effect ends, the target takes 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Aura of Dread

traits.name: Daywalker

traits.name: Rejuvenation

traits.name: Spider Climb

actions.name: Vladimir von Drakken always takes his turn on Initiative count 20

Vladimir von Drakken regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt. A Humanoid killed by this damage rises on its next turn as a Vampire Spawn under Vladimir von Drakken's control.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.value: The Avatar of Slaughter has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its Hit Points.

traits.name: Imprison in Weapon
traits.value: When the Avatar of Slaughter is reduced to 0 Hit Points by a melee Weapon Attack by a creature within 5 feet, its spirit infests the weapon that struck the blow. The weapon gains the properties and Curse associated with a Berserker Axe, though it retains its original weapon type. Additionally, while the curse remains the weapon is sentient and can telepathically communicate with any creature that wields it, encouraging violence and malice.

traits.value: The Avatar of Slaughter has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If the Avatar of Slaughter is destroyed, and not imprisoned in a weapon, it reforms and regains all its Hit Points in 1d6 days unless a __Wish__ spell is cast on its remains.

traits.name: Silver Weakness
traits.value: Damage dealt by Silver weapons ignores the avatar's Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.value: The Avatar of Slaughter's Long Jump is up to 60 feet and its High Jump is up to 30 feet, with or without a running start.

If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the Avatar of Slaughter moved at least 20 feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (**2d8**) Piercing damage and has the Stunned condition until the end of the target's next turn.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Beetle Knight is surprisingly agile, rarely standing still in battle. They charge during the first round, flinging enemies aside or attempting to grapple. If possible, they back up to charge again but will otherwise defend with their arm blades. They attempt to flee losing battles where their Hit Points fall below half their maximum.

actions.name: Pincer Horn

If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and the beetle knight can't use its Pincer Horn against another target.

bonusActions.name: Fling

If the target strikes a solid surface, it takes 3 (**1d6**) Bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and have the Prone condition.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Flying Blood-Drinker

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Weak Mind

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Belfray attempts to strike with a Sonic Blast from the shadows before engaging. Once a target is weakened, it swoops in with its claws. When damaged, Belfrays Bite, feeding on the blood of their victims to regain strength. It uses movement to stay away from threats, diving to attack before flying to a safe distance. If reduced below half of its maximum Hit Points, it attempts to fly away.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Stealth

actions.name: Punch Down
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

bonusActions.name: Brace Up

bonusActions.name: Combo

bonusActions.name: Enraging Insult

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Acidic Mucus!
fluffInfo.value: You're aware of her Acid Spew attack.

fluffInfo.value: You recognize Big Linda's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Big Linda sends Acid Spew against groups of opponents. She then tries to optimize her Bite and Tail attacks by placing herself within her enemies. She is hesitant to leave the Deep Haze but is also not smart enough to resist chasing those who antagonizing her. She rarely flees unless severely wounded, wherein she will seek the safety of the Deep Haze to recover.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If Big Linda is destroyed and her corpse is left within an area of the Deep Haze for 1 hour, she is revived with all of her Hit Points.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: When Big Linda starts her turn in an area of the Deep Haze, she regains 10 Hit Points. Big Linda dies only if she starts her turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Big Linda makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 33 (**4d12 + 7**) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and Big Linda can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 20 (**3d8 + 7**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Acid Spew (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 63 (**14d8**) Acid damage. *Success* Half damage.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.value: If Bigger Linda is destroyed and her corpse is left within an area of the Deep Haze for 1 hour, she is revived with all of her Hit Points.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: When Bigger Linda starts her turn in an area of the Deep Haze, she regains 20 Hit Points. Bigger Linda dies only if she starts her turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Haze Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Bigger Linda is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 22. *Failure:* The target gains a Contamination level. *Failure or Success*: 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.value: Bigger Linda deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.value: Bigger Linda has Immunity to any spell or effect that would alter her form.

actions.name: Bigger Linda always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On her turn, Bigger Linda can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Bigger Linda takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bite**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 35 (**4d12 + 9**) Piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 23). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and Bigger Linda can't Bite another target.

**Tail**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 22 (**3d8 + 9**) Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed 20 feet away from Bigger Linda and has the Prone condition.
**Stomp**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +15, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 25 (**3d10 + 9**) Bludgeoning damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 23. *Failure:* The target has the Staggered condition (save ends).

actions.name: Breathe Deep
actions.value: Bigger Linda's Breath Weapon recharges. Bigger Linda can only take this Epic Action as the first Epic Action she uses this round. After using this Epic Action, Bigger Linda can't take her Bite Epic Action until the start of the next round.

actions.name: Breath Weapon (Special Recharge)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 22, each creature in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide Line. *Failure:* 31 (**7d8**) Necrotic damage plus 31 (**7d8**) Force damage, and the target gains a Contamination level. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Trampling Rampage (Recharges When *Bloodied*)
actions.value: Bigger Linda moves up to her Speed in a straight line, moving through the space of Large or smaller creatures in her path. She makes one Stomp attack against each creature she moves through.

actions.name: Teleport (1/Round)
actions.value: Bigger Linger teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see within the Deep Haze.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Bigger Linda chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. Bigger Linda can use this Epic Action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

It produces large amounts of acidic bile in its guts that it expels when threatened. A Bloated Dreg will retreat to its watery home when threatened, trying to hide amongst the contaminated liquids.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The Bloated Gastromorph regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the Bloated Gastromorph takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the Bloated Gastromorph's next turn. The Bloated Gastromorph dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The Bloated Gastromorph can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Bloated Gastromorph makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a Tongue attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Slashing damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) and is moved up to 5 feet toward the Bloated Gastromorph.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 27 (**4d10 + 5**) Piercing damage.

If the Bloated Gastromorph takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it regurgitates all swallowed creatures at the end of that turn, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the gastromorph and has the Prone condition. If the Bloated Gastromorph dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

actions.name: Tongue (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Melee Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 25 ft., one target. *Hit:* 31 (**4d12 + 5**) Acid damage. A creature that is hit by this attack is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* The target has the Paralyzed condition and is moved up to 20 feet toward the gastromorph. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

bonusActions.name: Swallow
bonusActions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the gastromorph (it can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time). *Failure:* The target is swallowed by the gastromorph, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the gastromorph, and taks 21 (**6d6**) Acid damage at the start of each of the gastromorph's turns.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study a Bloated Hive, recognizing the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Sightless Awareness
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's Immunities and senses.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Endless Insects!
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Spawn Swarm action and Disrupt the Hive trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Frail
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Bloated Hive's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Bloated Hive is usually a solitary creature that spends its time cowering in dark corners living out its cursed life as nothing more than a conduit for its colony. In combat, they focus entirely on keeping their distance from threats and spawning swarms of insects to defend themselves. If cornered, the Bloated Hive uses its Claws and Distracting Swarm before moving back into the shadows and attempting to escape and find a new nest.

Larger packs of Bloated Hives are much braver and more violent, and actively hunt and pursue targets until their numbers are less than their prey. Places where large colonies gather are dangerous. The Bloated Hives work in unison to protect their nests. Only if they become outnumbered do they flee.

actions.name: Spawn Swarm (Recharge 5-6)

bonusActions.name: Distracting Swarm
bonusActions.value: The bloated hive causes its Insect Swarm to fly in the face of a creature within 5 feet of it. The target can't take Reactions until the end of the bloated hive's turn.

traits.name: Aquatic Camouflage
traits.value: The leech has Advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in aquatic terrain.

traits.name: Blood Bags
traits.value: The leech has three blood bags in its body. When encountered, roll 1d3 to determine how many blood bags are filled with blood. The rest are empty.

actions.name: Attach
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 0 ft. *Hit:* The leech attaches to the target. While attached, the leech doesn't attack, and moves with the target, using none of the leech's movement. The leech can detach itself using 5 feet of movement, and detaches immediately if its blood bags are filled or if the target dies.

A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the leech with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (*Medicine*) check. *Failure:* The leech is still detached, but the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4). Failure by 5 or More: The leech isn't detached and the target takes 8 (**2d4 + 3**) Piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Blood Drain
bonusActions.value: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature. The attached creature loses 10 (3d6) Hit Points due to blood loss, and the blood leech fills one of its empty blood bags with some of the target's blood.

bonusActions.name: Blood Transfusion
bonusActions.value: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature and has at least one filled blood bag. The attached creature regains 10 3d6 Hit Points, and the leech empties one of its filled blood bags.

traits.name: Electric Invigoration
traits.value: Whenever a Body Snatcher would take Lightning damage, it absorbs the energy and instead gains Temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage, rounded down. The Body Snatcher also immediately recharges its Electric Torrent ability.

traits.name: Skin Sack
traits.value: The Body Snatcher is physically indistinguishable from its host and cannot be detected by nonmagical means. If the Body Snatcher is reduced to 0 Hit Points, and it has been inside its current host for less than 24 hours, the host regurgitates it then has the Unconscious condition and 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Body Snatcher makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Invade
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 15; one Humanoid creature Grappled by the Body Snatcher. *Failure:* The Body Snatcher departs its current host and moves into the Grappled creature. It then regains all Hit Points and recharges Electric Torrent. If it had been inside its previous host for less than 24 hours, that creature has the Unconscious condition and 1 Hit Point. Otherwise, the previous host body becomes a lifeless skin sack.

actions.name: Electric Torrent (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The Body Snatcher unleashes a large electric pulse. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each other creature within 20 feet of the Body Snatcher. *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Lightning damage. *Success* Half damage.

fluffInfo.value: You know the Body Snatcher's condition Immunities.

fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Clinging Shadows trait.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) In the Dark of Night
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Body Snatcher's Sunlight Weakness trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Body Snatcher sticks to dimly lit areas or places of complete darkness. It teleports up to a creature and attempts to grapple it, teleporting away as soon as it has one or two targets in its hands. Often the Body Snatcher will emerge from tunnels or secret entrances to its lair. They do not travel far from the labs they were created in and often have easy points of escape to disappear once they have a victim in hand.

Each time a creature attempts to escape the body snatcher's grapple while it is in Dim Light or Darkness, the creature takes 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage. If this Necrotic damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target is stabilized but has the Paralyzed condition for 1 hour, even if it regains Hit Points.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness

bonusActions.name: Shadow Teleport
bonusActions.value: The body snatcher teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space that it can see that is in Dim Light or Darkness. It can bring any Medium or smaller creature it is grappling, teleporting that creature to an unoccupied space it can see within 5 feet of its destination that is also in Dim Light or Darkness. An unwilling creature can make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw to resist being teleported. On a successful save, neither the creature nor the body snatcher __Teleport__.

The Bojack can climb walls and will try and skitter up buildings or behind walls, springing back out to attack before escaping again. If brought below 20 Hit Points, the Bojack attempts to Dash away and Hide.

actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**4d6 + 4**) Piercing damage and the target is Bleeding (2d6). While Bleeding in this way, the target is also Slowed.

actions.name: Corrosive Mucus
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7 to hit, range 30/60 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**4d4 + 4**) Acid damage and the target is Burning (2d4 Acid). While Burning in this way, the target's AC becomes 10 + its Dexterity modifier.

bonusActions.name: Predatory Cunning
bonusActions.value: The bojack takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

fluffInfo.value: *Voracious Carrion Eater*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: A lingering result of the fey bargain that created them, boneflayers are disoriented and diminished by loud, thunderous noises.

entries: **Languages**: Sylvan; understands Common but can't speak it

traits.name: Flyby
traits.value: The boneflayer doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Thunderous Ward
traits.value: When the boneflayer hears a drum or gong, or takes Thunder damage, it has Disadvantage on D20 Tests until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The boneflayer makes one Beak attack and one Talons attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Slashing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Talons
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from both talons. While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.

bonusActions.name: Swoop (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: If the boneflayer has a creature Grappled, the boneflayer flies up to half its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and drops that creature.

fluffInfo.value: *Tricksy Fey Weasels*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Boogleswarms go wild for sugar, whether pure or in heavily-sweetened foods like candy, and are compelled to take and consume any they find.

entries: **Languages**: understands Common but can only speak if the swarm has gathered at least one Humanoid tooth

traits.name: Mimicry (Only if the Swarm Can Speak)
traits.value: The swarm can speak in the voice of a creature whose tooth it has implanted (see the Bite action). Listeners must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom (*Insight*) check to discern the mimicry.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.value: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny __weasel__. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Sweet Tooth
traits.value: If the swarm can see or smell sugar at the start of its turn, it must use all its movement to move closer to the sugar. If it reaches the sugar, the swarm has the Incapacitated condition until the start of its next turn as it consumes the sugar, and this trait doesn't function again until the swarm finishes a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The swarm makes two Bite attacks that must have different targets.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**4d4**) Piercing damage, or 5 (**2d4**) Piercing damage if the swarm is *Bloodied*. If the target is a creature that has teeth, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or lose one of its teeth. The swarm immediately implants the tooth into one of its mouths. A creature that has already lost a tooth to this attack automatically succeeds on the saving throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The boxer makes three attacks, using Grasping Strike or Punch Down in any combination.

actions.name: Grasping Strike
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Punch Down
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

bonusActions.name: Brace Up
bonusActions.value: The boxer gains 18 (4d8) Temporary Hit Points.

bonusActions.name: Combo
bonusActions.value: The boxer makes one Grasping Strike or Punch Down attack.

fluffInfo.name: Roleplaying Traits
fluffInfo.value: The following traits can be used to inspire roleplaying the Cacophonous Chimera:

entries: **Personality Trait:** "Just ONCE can we chat with someone a little before we eat them? RARGH! STOP TALKING! RIP AND TEAR! NO! NO! NO! Our stomach is FOUR TIMES bigger than it used to be! I'm STARVING!"
**Bond:** "We're fused together. Although each of us wants to be separated, in truth we're afraid of what would happen if we were ever torn apart."
**Ideal:** "I make such wonderful music! Each howl, shriek, and chitter resonates to form a deadly orchestra. I can't stand silence!"
**Flaw:** "We're constantly arguing. Our internal strife often distracts us from opportunities or leads us into traps, as we can't agree even on the simplest decisions."

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they Study a Cacophonous Chimera, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Freakish Fusion
fluffInfo.value: You're aware of the chimera's Epic Resistance Epic Action.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Fighting for Control
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the chimera's Cacophony Epic Action, noting that if the creature could be silenced, it would be far less formidable.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Powerful but Distracted
fluffInfo.value: You understand its strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Desperate to eat and consume, the Cacophonous Chimera viciously attacks prey on sight despite the desires of its harpy head to engage in a little conversation first. The Cacophonous Chimera is not a very subtle hunter. Its prey can hear it coming by the sound of its droning cacophony from at least a city block away, which may give them opportunity to prepare, hide, or flee.

The range of its Cacophony can affect creatures before they can see the chimera itself. By the time the chimera arrives, its prey may be shaken and immobilized by the sound. Depending on how ravenous and furious it is, the chimera closes with its prey and tears them apart using its Claws, Bite, and Tail.

Against a target that shows resilience to its cacophony or who retaliates with formidable attacks of their own, the chimera keeps a middle distance, trying to keep out of melee range while leaving its foes in its Cacophonous Chorus aura. However, its ravenous Garmyr head and Ratling head can often get in the way of the better judgment here, prompting the chimera to engage in melee even when it would not be advantageous.

Furthermore, the three creatures are generally too busy arguing or overconfident to think twice about the actual danger and stakes they might be facing, and so may need to be grievously wounded before fleeing is an option.

traits.name: Cacophonous Chorus
traits.value: The cacophonous chimera creates a 30-foot Emanation of noise. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation that can hear it takes 10 (**3d6**) Thunder damage.

traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.value: The cacophonous chimera has Advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight or smell.

actions.name: The cacophonous chimera always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the cacophonous chimera can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the cacophonous chimera takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Claws and Talons**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**1d10 + 6**) Slashing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it has the Prone condition.

**Contaminated Bite (1/Round)**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**2d10 + 6**) Piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* The target gains a Contamination level.

actions.name: Lamprey Tail
actions.value: Melee Attack Roll:+11, reach 30 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4).

actions.name: Aerial Maneuver (1/Round)
actions.value: The cacophonous chimera flies up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Cacophony (1/Round)
actions.value: The cacophonous chimera's three heads sing a discordant song. The effect of the song varies based on which of the chimera's head is taking the lead. Each time the cacophonous chimera uses this Epic Action, it can't use the same effect it chose last round.

actions.name: Bewildering Chitter (Ratling)
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the chimera that can hear it. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Bewildered condition (save ends).

actions.name: Chilling Howl (Garmyr)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the cacophonous chimera that can hear it. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Cold damage, and the target has the Immobilized condition (save ends).

actions.name: Staggering Screech (Harpy)
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the cacophonous chimera that can hear it. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Staggered condition (save ends).

actions.name: Wing Blast
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature within 15 feet of the cacophonous chimera. *Failure:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet away from the chimera. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The cacophonous chimera chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The cacophonous chimera can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.value: If Ansom is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails, provided he doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Ansom makes four attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the end of Ansom's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Flurry of Blades
bonusActions.value: Ansom makes two Shortsword attacks.

fluffInfo.value: *Hag of Pestilence and Flesh-Shaping*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Centipede hags draw more than strength from the filth that covers them; it is the essence of their being. Scrubbing it away dissolves the hag.

traits.name: Scoured Filth
traits.value: The hag is burned by soapy water. Treat a bucket or flask of it splashed on the hag as a vial of Acid. If the hag is fully immersed in soapy water at the start of its turn, it takes 20 Acid damage.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The hag can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hag makes two Bite attacks or uses Spellcasting to cast __Contagion__. It can also use Warping Caress.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Piercing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the hag's next turn.

actions.name: Warping Caress
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17, one creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* 19 (**4d6 + 5**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains 1 Exhaustion level. Until the target's Exhaustion level is reduced to 0, its body is warped and twisted, and it has Disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws that use Strength or Dexterity. *Success* Half damage only. *Failure or Success*: If a Humanoid dies from this action, the hag can spend 2 days of work to shape its corpse into a __Deepdreck__, or it can combine it with the corpse of a horse to create a __Fleshdobbin__.

fluffInfo.value: The Cerebrograft is a horrific attempt to combine two creatures into a singular form, a nightmarish combination of brains and brawn. Through surgical implantation and flesh-melding, an apothecary creates a forced symbiosis, fusing their nervous systems and unlocking potent psionic abilities.

fluffInfo.name: Improved Lackeys
fluffInfo.value: A Cerebrograft is often the "reward" granted to a pair of loyal lab assistants, a means of "removing deficiencies" by combining their bodies and minds, frequently named a portmanteau of its constituent beings.

fluffInfo.name: Dominant Personality
fluffInfo.value: Although intended to be a symbiosis of two minds, typically, the implanted creature subsumes the psyche of its host, fully controling the new form. However, sometimes, the two beings form a constituent mind combining elements of the originals, or even a bicameral mind where the original two debate internally over what action to take.

fluffInfo.name: Delicate Work
fluffInfo.value: Thanks to their psionic abilities, Cerebrografts are well suited to controlling other test subjects. Apothecaries find their precise telekinetic powers especially useful in surgical procedures and laboratory experiments.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Cerebrograft, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Occult Fleshmending
fluffInfo.value: You uncover the Cerebrograft's Dual Minds trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Powerful Psionics
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its Telekinetic Grip and Psychic Crush.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Powerful, Clumsy, and Slow
fluffInfo.value: You learn the Cerebrograft's ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Despite its physical and psionic might, Cerebrografts prefers fighting alongside allies of its apothecary master. When confronted with multiple foes, it tries to overwhelm their minds using Psychic Crush to escape and find reinforcements.

A Cerebrograft uses its Telekinetic Grip to hold its enemies, unruly test subjects, and wild experiments at bay. It typically focuses on one target, allowing allies to pummel the Restrained foe. If it can, it uses the environment to its advantage, moving foes to restrain them such as into mancles, cages, or surgery tables.

traits.name: Dual Minds
traits.value: The cerebrograft has Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, and Unconscious conditions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The cerebrograft makes two Slam attacks and uses Telekinetic Grip.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Telekinetic Grip
actions.value: The cerebrograft reaches out with its mind to hold one creature or object it can see within 120 feet of it in its psychic grasp. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target is moved up to 30 feet in any direction and has the Restrained condition until the start of the cerebrograft's next turn or until the cerebrograft has the Incapacitated condition.

If the target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is telekinetically moved up to 30 feet in any direction. The cerebrograft can also exert fine control on objects with its telekinesis, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.

actions.name: Psychic Crush (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the cerebrograft. *Failure:* 22 (**4d10**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Dazed condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: The target instead has the Stunned condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.value: *The only chemists I admire are the ones who make Caspian cinnamon rolls. This is not one of them.*

Chemists indulge in the science of the alchemical, often harnessing the raw potential of elemental formulae while creating unique compounds and reagents. They have been known to dabble in the science behind the creation of elementals and oozes, and perfecting explosives and acids.

fluffInfo.name: Chemist Minions
fluffInfo.value: Although Chemists often do not dabble in creating creatures, any apothecary can make use of minions. Simple elementals and oozes can be found in a Chemist's lab. __Tankers__ work as a good lab assistant for administering large amounts of chemical formulae for the scientist, while __Living Biohazards__ are often the failed early experiments many Chemists. A __Chemystral__ is the ultimate pride and joy of many chemists.

entries: **Personality Trait:** I revel in the chaos and destruction that my concoctions cause, watching the flames and corrosion with maniacal laughter and a crazed gleam in my eyes.
**Bond:** Creativity is born from chaos; the most groundbreaking discoveries require pushing boundaries, no matter the dangers involved.
**Ideal:** I am obsessed with avenging my mentor, who was persecuted by those who feared our knowledge and power.

**Flaw:** My obsession with perfecting destructive formulae often leads me to take careless risks, sabotaging my own work and safety. I've burned down my own workshop more times than I can remember, and I'll do it again.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Chemist, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Resistance from Exposure
fluffInfo.value: You know of the Chemist's damage Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Masters of Compounds
fluffInfo.value: You learn the Chemist's Critical Condition trait and Explosive Compound action. (20+) Mental, not Physical, Prowess. You are aware of the Chemist's AC and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Chemists opt to start things off with a bang, unleashing their Explosive Concoction on the first round, especially against a grouped together party. They use Acid Rain to create a dangerous zone between them and their enemies and default to unleashing their Chemical Spray on enemies stuck in the difficult area. If a creature closes the distance on the Chemist, they use their Caustic Grip. If they find themselves surrounded or outnumbered in close quarters, they attempt to escape.

traits.name: Critical Condition
traits.value: A creature that rolls a natural 1 on a saving throw against the chemist's attacks or effects takes maximum damage from the attack or effect.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: Chemist is immune to the Burning condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chemist makes one Caustic Grip attack and uses either Chemical Spray or Explosive Concoction, if available.

actions.name: Caustic Grip
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 24 (**8d4 + 4**) Acid damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition and the chemist can't use Caustic Grip against another target. At the end of each of its turns, the target takes 24 (**8d4 + 4**) Acid damage.

actions.name: Chemical Spray
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (the chemist's choice). *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Explosive Concoction (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 20-foot radius Sphere centered on a point within 120 feet of the chemist. *Failure:* 45 (**10d8**) Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage (the chemist's choice), and the target has the Burning condition (4d6, same damage type). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Acid Rain (1/Day)
actions.value: The chemist conjures a storm of acid rain in a 20-foot radius, 20-foot tall Cylinder centered on a point it can see within 120 feet. Exposed flames in the area are doused. Chemical pools accumulate in the area and emit thick fumes, rendering it Difficult Terrain and Lightly Obscured. The storm and the pools evaporate after 1 minute.

A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there is subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* 30 (**12d4**) Acid damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Emergency Dose
bonusActions.value: The chemist administers a restorative poultice to itself or a creature it can see within 5 feet that isn't a Construct or Undead. The target regains 35 10d6 Hit Points. Once a creature benefits from Emergency Dose, it can't do so again until it finishes a Short or Long Rest.

fluffInfo.value: One of a __Chemist__'s ultimate creations, the Chemystral is a perfectly balanced sentient compound capable of altering its physiology to adapt to surrounding threats. The horrific ooze has the ability to stick to any surface and even propel itself into the air and fly. It is impervious to nearly all forms of elemental attack. Much like a chameleon changing its color to blend into its surroundings, the Chemystral changes itself at a cellular level to adapt to environmental changes and elemental threats, gaining properties to better combat predators. Even with its inherent resilience, the Chemystral is unable to adapt to the cold, or deal with intense sound.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Chemystral, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Living Chemical Reaction
fluffInfo.value: You know the Chemystral's

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Elemental Adaption
fluffInfo.value: You uncover the Chemystral's Elemental Reaction trait.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Weakness to Cold
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Chemystral's Cold Vulnerability trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Chemystral attempts to Engulf as many victims as it can. It cares little about taking elemental damage and only thinks to retreat if it is consistently taking Cold damage.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Ooze.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Goopy Ooze, Elemental Fluid.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Glands.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant
**Immunities**: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing; blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Amorphous Form
traits.value: The chemystral can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

traits.name: Cold Vulnerability
traits.value: If the chemystral takes Cold damage, it becomes Frozen (DC 15). While it has the Frozen condition, it loses its Immunities to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage and its Resistance to Force damage, and it gains Vulnerability to Thunder damage. In addition to the normal means, the Frozen condition ends if the chemystral takes 20 points of Force, Piercing, Thunder, or Slashing damage.

traits.name: Elemental Reaction
traits.value: If the Chemystral takes Acid, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Necrotic damage, it takes on elemental properties which change the damage type of its Chemical Spray and Engulf actions to match that damage type. In addition, it causes an additional effect when it hits with its Chemical Spray attack:

traits.name: Acid
traits.value: On a hit, the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Acid).

traits.name: Fire
traits.value: On a hit, the target has the Burning condition (4d6 Fire).

traits.name: Lightning
traits.value: On a hit, the target has the Shocked condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Poison
traits.value: On a hit, the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Necrotic
traits.value: On a hit, the chemystral regains Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The chemystral regains 25 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the chemystral takes Cold or Thunder damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The chemystral dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Sonic Neutralization
traits.value: When the chemystral takes Thunder damage, it loses any active benefit from its Elemental Reaction trait.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chemystral makes two Chemical Spray attacks and uses Engulf.

actions.name: Chemical Spray
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. *Hit:* 35 (**10d6**) Acid damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.value: The chemystral moves up to its Speed. While doing so, it can enter Large or smaller creatures' spaces. Whenever the chemystral enters a creature's space, the creature is subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Success* The creature can choose to be pushed 5 feet back or to the side of the chemystral. A creature that chooses not to be pushed suffers the consequences of a failed saving throw.

*Failure:* The chemystral enters the creature's space, and the creature takes 35 (**10d6**) Acid damage and is engulfed. The engulfed creature can't breathe, has the Restrained condition, and takes 35 (**10d6**) Acid damage at the start of each of the chemystral's turns. The engulfed creature has Total Cover from effects outside the chemystral. When the chemystral moves, the engulfed creature moves with it.

The chemystral can hold only one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time. An engulfed creature can take an action to escape with a successful DC 17 Strength check, entering a space of its choice within 5 feet of the ooze.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study a Chitinous Dreg, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Protective Plates
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Dreg's AC.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Pinning Blades
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Bone Blade attack and No Escape trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Sturdy Foe
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Chitinous Dreg's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Chitinous Dregs often charge into the front lines of combat. It positions itself between other Dregs and their foes almost as if it was defending its allies. Chitinous Dregs attempt to draw the combat towards itself at all times, using its Bone Blades to keep the focus on it, and its Sentinel Strike Reaction and No Escape trait to ensure creatures facing it cannot get away. The Chitinous Dreg is a warrior and rarely retreats: it is too enraged with a protective bloodlust when thrust into battle to worry about its own wellbeing.

traits.name: No Escape
traits.value: When the dreg hits a creature with an Opportunity Attack action, that creature's Speed becomes 0 until the end of its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The dreg makes two Bone Blade attacks.

actions.name: Bone Blade
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 4**) Force damage, and the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against any creature other than the dreg until the end of its next turn.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Animal Handling* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Nature*) checks to Study a Chitter, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Wall Crawling
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Climb Speed, its Running Leap trait, and its Slow Fall feature.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Madding Noise
fluffInfo.value: You know of its Chitter attack action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Simple Minded
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its mental ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Chitters often attack in a small group. Usually two to three that form a family will stick together. The mutated squirrels have been known to be quite territorial and hostile, even to other Chitter families who try to infringe on their territory.

Chitters are excellent climbers, capable of falling a great distance without fear of hurting themselves. It is not uncommon for Chitters to be found in tall buildings, or up on the top floor of ruined houses, or hard-to-reach rooftops or attics. Chitters charge their enemies and leap at them, attempting to disable them with their chittering, and relying on their Claws and Bite. Chitters protect their homes with determined ferocity, but if reduced to less than a third of their Hit Points, they leap and clamber away.

traits.name: Running Leap
traits.value: As long as the chitter has moved 20+ feet this turn, it has a high jump and long jump of 30 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chitter makes two Sharpened Claws attacks and one Acrid Bite attack. It can also use Chitter, if available.

actions.name: Acrid Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) Piercing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Sharpened Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Chitter (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature within 120 feet of the chitter that can hear it. *Failure:* The target has the Dazed condition until the end of the chitter's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Aggressive
bonusActions.value: The chitter moves up to its Speed toward a Hostile creature it can see. If it ends this movement adjacent to the creature, it gains Advantage on attack rolls against that creature until the end of its turn.

entries: **Immunities**: poison, psychic; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Swarm
traits.value: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through an opening large enough for a Small creature. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The swarm makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**4d4 + 3**) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The colour out of space has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The colour out of space makes two Draining Lash attacks.

actions.name: Draining Lash
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, Reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 20 (**3d8 + 6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Absorb Life (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17, non-Mythos creatures in a 30-foot Emanation centered on the colour out of space. *Failure:* 44 (**8d10**) Necrotic damage. *Success* Half damage. If three or more creatures fail their saving throw against this effect, the colour out of space gains an additional action on its next turn.

bonusActions.name: Horrid Burrowing
bonusActions.value: The colour out of space destroys an unattended, non-magical object that it can touch that has Hit Points less than or equal to the colour's maximum Hit Points.

traits.name: Dispersal
traits.value: When the congregation is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it leaves behind 2d4 Pilgrims in its place.

traits.name: Mob
traits.value: The congregation can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the congregation can move through any opening large enough for a Medium Humanoid. The congregation can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The congregation makes one attack against each creature in its space.

actions.name: Torches
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 0 ft. *Hit:* The target has the Burning condition (4d6 Fire).

actions.name: Pitchforks
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 0 ft. *Hit:* 28 (**8d6**) Piercing damage, or 14 (**4d6**) Piercing damage if the congregation has the *Bloodied* condition. The target has the Prone condition.

bonusActions.name: Trample
bonusActions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature in the congregation's space that has the Prone condition. *Failure:* 17 (**2d10 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage. *Success* Half damage.

fluffInfo.value: *Grain Husk Companion (Curved blade plated in gold)*

traits.name: Husk Body
traits.value: The corn dolly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Uneasy Visage
traits.value: The strange, childlike inked face unnerves onlookers. While a creature is holding the corn dolly, creatures within 10 feet of it have Disadvantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made against the creature.

actions.name: Husk Cut
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 1 Slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Blank Stare
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature the corn dolly can see within 30 feet. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Sowing Dread (2/Day)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature of the corn dolly's choice in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

fluffInfo.value: *Demon of Hunger and Secrets*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Savvy demon hunters bar corvodaemons with warding lines of ash prepared from feathers.

traits.name: Ashen Forbiddance
traits.value: The corvodaemon can't cross a line of ashes created by burning feathers sprinkled with Holy Water.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.value: If the corvodaemon dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Devour Anima
traits.value: A creature the corvodaemon reduced to 0 Hit Points is cursed until it regains any Hit Points. When the cursed creature fails a Death Saving Throw at the start of its turn, it dies regardless of how many failures it has.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: The corvodaemon can mimic the voice of any creature it has heard, or of a creature known to one of the creatures within range of its telepathy. A hearer can discern the voices are imitations with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (*Insight*) check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The corvodaemon can use Feeding Frenzy if available. It then makes one Beak attack and one Claws attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**2d4 + 3**) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Feeding Frenzy (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The corvodaemon enters a voracious feeding frenzy, driven by its insatiable hunger for souls. Until the start of its next turn, the corvodaemon's Speed doubles, and when it damages a creature, it gains Temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage taken.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they Study a Crater Wurm, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Subterranean Threat
fluffInfo.value: You know it has Tremorsense and that it creates tunnels when digging through rock.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Earth Shaker
fluffInfo.value: You're aware of the Crater Wurms' Breach and Bite attacks.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Blunderous Brute
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Crater Wurms' strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Crater Wurms disregard other creatures, viewing them as only morsels to consume. All are as the dust of the earth to it—simply food. These wurms understand that creatures they devour often try to flee. Their favored tactic is to remain buried until their Tremorsense detects movement. They then surface with its Breach action, making Bite attacks, swallowing nearby Prone creatures. They dive beneath the ground once at least one creature is swallowed, or if reduced to half its Hit Point maximum.
