traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The lepidoptera is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The lepidoptera may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the lepidoptera can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the lepidoptera has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The lepidoptera is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the lepidoptera's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Energy Form
traits.value: The lepidoptera can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature is moved 20 feet in a random direction.

traits.name: Incomprehensible Vision
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the lepidoptera and can see it is subjected to the following effect. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13. *Failure:* The target has the Staggered condition until the start of its next turn. *Success* The target is transported to the Border Ethereal. If the target is already on the Border Ethereal, they are transported to the Material Plane instead.

Unless *surprised*, a creature can avert their eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of their turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the lepidoptera until the start of its next turn. If the creature looks at the lepidoptera in the meantime, that creature must immediately make the saving throw.

traits.name: Multidimensional Presence
traits.value: If the lepidoptera is reduced to 0 Hit Points but hasn't taken damage from a source on both the Material Plane and the Border Ethereal in the last round, it drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

traits.name: Phototaxis
traits.value: If a source of Bright Light is within 100 feet of the lepidoptera, it attempts to move closer to the light on its turn.

traits.name: Unraveling Reality
traits.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the lepidoptera when it dies. *Success* The target is transported from the Material Plane to the Border Ethereal, or vice versa.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lepidoptera makes two Fractal Wing attacks.

actions.name: Fractal Wing
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 35 (**5d10 + 7**) Force damage.

actions.name: Tessellation (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the lepidoptera that doesn't have Total Cover. *Failure:* 44 (**8d10**) Force damage, and the target begins its next turn by moving up to its Speed in a random direction.

If the target has the Staggered condition, it instead takes no damage, that condition ends, and the target has the Incapacitated condition (save ends). While Incapacitated, the target mutters rhymes in a singsong voice and dances to an unheard rhythm, moving up to its Speed in a random direction at the start of each of its turns.

The war dogs are brutal fighters, and feel no fear, but if their numbers dwindle, they retreat to regroup. They prefer to attack as a pack, and with intention; if the battle becomes too chaotic and more than half their numbers are gone, they flee into the streets.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Garmyr warriors fight as a pack, following their leader on the hunt. They choose the juiciest, most delicious-looking target as their prey, favoring unarmored or feeble-looking creatures. Garmyr group up and focus their attacks until they bring down their target, unless a more dangerous threat prompts them to respond.

Garmyr crave blood and close-quarters battle, closing the distance to attack with their bites even when it may be more advantageous for them to keep their distance using their spears. Garmyr don't stop attacking a foe once they've downed them—they start feasting instead. Garmyr make Bite attacks against downed foes in the midst of battle, making Unconscious and dying characters especially vulnerable to the Garmyr's appetites.

Garymr are mostly heedless in battle unless their numbers are significantly cut down. Although they prefer to start battles when they outnumber their enemies, they flee as the fight turns against them. However, Garmyr might also attempt to flee once they've secured a meal—a group of Garmyr who manage to down one character in a group might decide to scoop up the victim and enjoy their meal elsewhere rather than continuing to fight.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Giant Ratling will charge any enemy it sees that threatens its burrow or gets in its way. The ratling will Enrage and start hurling other ratlings at its enemy as it charges forward, bearing down on the creature with claws and teeth. These brutes are relentless in their attacks, and generally much braver—or dumber—than other ratlings. They are unlikely to flee from harm.
If the rest of the ratlings begin to flee, the Giant Ratling will follow, but it will usually be the last to turn tail as it enjoys pummeling and gnawing on flesh a bit too much.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: When a creature draws a Graffiti's attention, it uses illusions to confuse its targets. It then uses Summon Public Opinion and watches the drama unfold. To keep things interesting, the Graffiti uses its Transposition ability to see how creatures respond to situations when they're forced to approach them from new perspectives.

When the graffiti is in the heart of the action, it targets the most influential creature with Satire. Should the graffiti decide its target is sufficiently entertaining, or dangerous, it will flee the situation. If the graffiti is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it plays dead and then escapes at the first opportunity.

traits.value: The graffiti is incapacitated while in the area of antimagic. If targeted by __Dispel Magic__, the graffiti must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or become Unconscious for 1 minute.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The graffiti regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the graffiti is splashed with water, targeted by __Prestidigitation__, or takes Cold damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. Its body is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Satire
actions.value: The graffiti shapes itself into a satirical representation of a foe. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature within 60 feet that can see the graffiti. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage and the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of the graffiti's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Transposition
actions.value: The air quivers around creatures near the graffiti. *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 15, up to five creatures the graffiti can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* The creature teleports to an unoccupied space capable of supporting the creature within 120 feet.

actions.name: Summon Public Opinion (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The graffiti conjures a swarm of Drakkenheim citizen spirits within 120 feet of itself. The swarm uses the Chorus stat block. The chorus acts immediately after the graffiti on the same Initiative count, and it obeys the graffiti. The chorus disappears after 1 minute or the graffiti dies

traits.name: Dazzling Aura
traits.value: The gravekeeper sheds Bright Light in a 60-foot radius. A creature that starts its turn in the Bright Light takes 10 (**3d6**) Radiant damage.

actions.name: The gravekeeper always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the gravekeeper can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the gravekeeper takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 22 (**4d8 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Lantern Blast
actions.value: Magical octarine beams flash from one of the Gravekeeper's many lanterns at one creature it can see within 120 feet that is not behind Total Cover, subjecting it to one of the following effects (the gravekeeper can only use each blast once per round):

entries: **Dispelling Blast**: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Psychic damage. Any spell or magical effect on the target ends, and it has the Bewildered condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.

**Forceful Blast**: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Force damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet away from the gravekeeper and has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.
**Blinding Blast**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.
**Contaminating Blast**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. *Success* Half damage only.
**Igniting Blast**: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Fire damage, and the target has the Burning condition (10d6 Fire). *Success* Half damage only.
**Freezing Blast**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Cold damage, and the target has the Frozen condition (DC 18). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Glide (1/Round)
actions.value: The gravekeeper moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action.

actions.name: Sludge Column (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature in a 10-foot radius, 60-foot tall Cylinder, centered on a point within 120 feet of the Gravekeeper. *Failure:* 42 (**12d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Animate Walls (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature within 10 feet of any number of walls within 120 feet of the gravekeeper. *Failure:* The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18). The wall sprouts limbs to facilitate this grapple, which disappear when the condition ends.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The gravekeeper chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting it and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The gravekeeper can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

traits.name: Even Death May Die
traits.value: When Great Cthulhu drops to 0 Hit Points or would be killed outright, it instead transforms into a cloud of green mist that fills its space. At the start of each of Great Cthulhu's turns, it gains one recovery point but otherwise cannot use actions or legendary actions other than Relentless Horror. When it gains its fourth recovery point, its maximum Hit Points return to normal if they have been reduced and it regains all lost Hit Points. It reforms its physical body in a space of its choice within 10 miles of its location. It then loses all recovery points.

If Great Cthulhu is the target of a __Banishment__ spell while in this cloud form cast with a 9th-level spell slot, it automatically fails its saving throw and is instead sent to R'lyeh where it slumbers for 10d10 years.

traits.name: Horrid Aura
traits.value: A non-mythos entity that starts its turn within 30 feet of Great Cthulhu takes 10 Psychic damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (6/Day)
traits.value: If Great Cthulhu fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Great Cthulhu makes six Crushing Claw attacks.

actions.name: Crushing Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +19, Reach 25 ft. *Hit:* 28 (**4d8 + 10**) Bludgeoning damage and the target is either knocked Prone or moved up to 20 ft. in a straight line from Great Cthulhu.

actions.name: Apocalyptic Majesty (Recharge 5-6)

This effect ends at the end of that turn.

fluffInfo.value: Guardians of flourishing alpine forests, great fir drakes live peacefully among their saplings. Each day, the iridescent drakes use powerful magic to replenish their forest's soil and promote the growth of their beloved fir trees. Over the centuries, villagers and townsfolk have learned to live in peace with these largely benevolent beings.

People who live near a great fir drake's lair can visit its forest home and leave the drake small shiny tokens under trees they wish to cut down. If the people return the next day to find the tokens have been gathered and taken, they know the great fir drake has given its blessing for those tree to be felled. In thanks, villagers decorate the trees with lights to resemble the drake. Those who fail to leave an offering for the drake's hoard and cut down its fir trees enrage the legendary creature, and should prepare to face its thrashing, needle-covered tail.

Grim Custodians can use __Nystul's Magic Aura__ and __nontection__ to foil divinations which would otherwise detect them, and __Major Image__ and Seeming to further disguise the truth.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Grotesque Gargantuans are violently territorial creatures. Unlike the randomly mutated creatures found throughout the Haze, these hideous entities are more in tune with the arcane elements of Drakkenheim. Their form appears more intentional, as does their purpose, though the truth behind this intention remains a mystery

Gargantuans often drag chunks of delerium along with them, and their massive arms can swing or throw them with ease. They place the stones in odd formations around the city and, if witnessed by another creature who isn't a Dreg or a Haze Hulk, they will violently lash out and chase the observerer down. The Gargantuan hurls huge boulders of delerium at them. Whatever their intention is, they will not abandon their territory, or their work, and rarely flee from the site they are working in.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Gutbuster is a massive, bloated hulk that constantly grows fleshy masses within its ever expanding belly. If left unchecked, a Gutbuster Hulk can grow to proportions so large that it crushes itself under its own weight. Ratlings love when this happens—it supplies them with food for weeks.

The Gutbuster maintains its form by ripping chunks of flesh from its body, hurling them at enemies. This contaminated flesh erupts in a shower of gore and necrotic fluids. A Gutbuster usually opens with this attack to ward off foes, and then waits for more flesh to grow to hurl it again. If its enemies close in around it, it uses its Bile Blast to coat the creatures in acid, or will Slam them with its massive fists.
The Gutbuster is slower moving than other Haze Hulks and rarely runs from a fight.

The Dreg uses its Reactive trait, as well as its Flailing Guts Reaction to knock creatures out of its way the moment they come near. It will always try to move away from direct combat, preferring to keep its enemies at arm's length so it can continue to pummel them with its Gut Flail.
The Gutwretch Dreg will fight to protect its fellow Dregs and is often the last one to flee from combat.

If forced into melee, she uses her Tentacle Hair to attack and will take the first opportunity to escape if she can.

traits.value: Lenore's long hair can latch onto surfaces to pull her in any direction. She has a Flying Speed of 40 feet (included in Speed) but cannot move more than 30 feet from a solid surface, including walls and ceilings.

actions.name: Lenore always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On her turn, she can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Lenore takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn.

actions.name: Tentacle Hair
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**4d4 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 21 (**6d6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Contaminated Eye Blast
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Force damage, plus 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 19. *Failure:* The target gains one level of Contamination.

actions.name: Grim Reveal (1/Round)
actions.value: Lenore removes her mask, revealing her horrific form. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 19, creatures within 60 feet of her who can see her. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Octarine Wall (1/Day)
actions.value: Lenore summons a shimmering wall within 120 feet of her. The wall can be up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick. Alternatively, she can shape the wall into a sphere up to 30 feet in diameter centered on a point she can see within range. The wall has three octarine layers. When a creature attempts to reach into or pass through the wall, it does so one layer at a time through all the wall's layers. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 19. Failure:

Layer 1: 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage and the target gains one level of Contamination and has the Dazed condition; Layer 2: 17 (**5d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains two levels of Contamination and has the Defenseless condition; Layer 3: 35 (**10d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains three levels of Contamination and the Helpless condition. *Success* Half damage only. The wall can be destroyed by taking at least 100 Radiant or Force damage.

actions.name: Radiant Gaze (1/Round)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 19, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 44 (**8d10**) Radiant damage and the target gains one level of Contamination. *Success* Half damage only. If Lenore sees her reflection within the Cone, she gains the Blinded and Incapacitated conditions for 1d6 hours and can't take the Epic Resistance Epic Action for the duration.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Lenore chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls 1d20. On an 11 or higher, the effect ends on her. Lenore can use this Epic Action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Haze Wights are intelligent warriors who can engage in melee or ranged combat. However, they mistakenly believe their foes are mindless monsters not requiring careful tactics, seeing most targets as beasts to be put down. When a foe demonstrates unexpected magic or strategy, some fight more carefully, commanding minions to surround and corner their opponents.

Groups of these wights sometimes believe they are still-living, acting as if they still possess their former abilities, using teamwork and "healing" each other by reanimating the fallen as Haze Husks. Nevertheless, their delusions render them incapable of imagining defeat; they do not flee when wounded, nor when allies fall. Instead, they believe they fight in a heroic last stand, desperately rallying against the inevitable doom they already suffered.

If they find themselves grounded, or outnumbered they will attempt to escape and fly to the highest location nearby to guard themselves and better defend against attackers.

fluffInfo.name: Roleplaying Traits
fluffInfo.value: Adventurers who interact with He Who Laughs Last must endure his mocking laughter and jeering comments, as he remarks on the futility of their actions, the dramatic irony of their mistakes, and the meaninglessness of their quests. In doing so, He Who Laughs Last carefully offers an escape or solution—if the adventurers will offer him service in exchange, one that is almost certain to have unforeseen consequences.

He Who Laughs Last loves nothing more than when mortal heroes attempt to outmaneuver him. As befitting his name, there is almost always some unfortunate upset or surprise twist the demon has in store. Even when he is seemingly defeated, he is always sure to remind his foes who will have the last laugh.

fluffInfo.name: Personality Traits
fluffInfo.value: In conversation, I cannot contain my dark mirth, which manifests from a low chuckle to a belly-bursting guffaw. Most of all, I love the moment when mortals realize the cost of their terrible mistakes and poor decisions.

fluffInfo.name: Ideal
fluffInfo.value: Mortals fear death. I play upon that fear, and with it I can catch the conscience of any soul.

fluffInfo.name: Bond
fluffInfo.value: I harvest of souls at life's curtain call, binding them to my cast of players in my Theatre of the Danse Macabre.

fluffInfo.name: Flaw
fluffInfo.value: I oft direct the play too long, delighting in extending the final act. My patience is as deep as the grave, allowing me to savor each move in the mortal game, though sometimes to the detriment of a timely demise.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Powerful Demonlord.
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of his Truesight and telepathy, his Resistances and Immunities, and his Epic

fluffInfo.name: Resistance.
fluffInfo.value: You also know this eldritch entity is beyond life and death and can reform years later if killed.

fluffInfo.name: (25+) Killing Aura.
fluffInfo.value: You know of his Mortal Coil aura, and his spellcasting Epic Actions.

fluffInfo.name: (30+) Powerful Presence.
fluffInfo.value: You know his highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: He Who Laughs Last approaches battle lazily, as his mere presence causes mortals to die in short order from his Mortal Coil aura. Nevertheless, he casually ends lives using Sleep No More, Dusty Death, and Out Brief Candle, trapping another foe in a Cage of Sorrows so they must bear witness to the death around them before they expire to his Mortal Coil.

He Who Laughs Last does not fear his own destruction, confident that he will reappear if his corporeal form is destroyed. He is certain of his fate to watch the end of the universe, and even when slain his echoing laughter remains as a grim reminder of his power.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.value: He Who Laughs Last is immune to any effect that would sense his emotions or read his thoughts, as well as any divination spell that he refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the demon lord's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Mortal Coil
traits.value: He Who Laughs Last projects a 150-foot Emanation of death and decay. A creature that ends its turn in the Emanation suffers an Exhaustion level and ages 10 (3d6) years. The creature removes an Exhaustion level gained in this way at the end of its turn, but only if it ends its turn outside the Emanation. A creature's original age can be restored with __Greater Restoration__ or similar magic.

actions.name: He Who Laughs Last always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, He Who Laughs Last can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, He Who Laughs Last takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Scornful Whip**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +16, reach 120 ft. *Hit:* 30 (**5d8 + 8**) Force damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, it is pulled 30 feet toward He Who Laughs Last.
**Walking Shadow (1/Round)**: He Who Laughs Last moves up to half his Speed.

actions.name: Sleep No More (1/Round)
actions.value: He Who Laughs Last casts __Power Word Kill__.

actions.name: Out Brief Candle (1/Round)
actions.value: He Who Laughs Last casts __Finger of Death__ (save DC 24).

actions.name: Dusty Death (1/Round)
actions.value: He Who Laughs Last casts __Disintegrate__ (save DC 24).

actions.name: Cage of Sorrows (1/Round)
actions.value: He Who Laughs Last creates a wall of bone on a solid surface it can see within 120 feet of himself. The wall appears as a flat surface made up of one 10-foot-square panel. The wall is 1 foot thick and lasts for 1 minute or until the wall is destroyed (AC 15, 20 Hit Points, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage, Vulnerability to Bludgeoning and Thunder damage).

If the wall cuts through a creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (GM's choice) and subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: He Who Laughs Last chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on him. He Who Laughs Last can use this action even if he would otherwise be unable to take actions, his actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters his game statistics.

actions.value: The scout makes two attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the end of the scout's next turn.

traits.name: Powder Keg
traits.value: If the trapper takes damage from a critical hit, it must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or the attack ruptures their alchemical supplies and gunpowder. Each creature within 15 feet of the trapper (including the trapper) is subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 12. *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Fire damage. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Trapper's Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 60/120 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d8 + 2**) Piercing damage, and the target is subjected to one of the following effects of the trapper's choice:

entries: **Bola Shot**: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 12. *Failure:* The target has the Prone condition.
**Tranquilizer Shot**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12. *Failure:* The target has the Dazed condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Net Shot (1/Day)
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 12. *Failure:* The target has the Immobilized condition (save ends).

actions.name: Set Trap (5/Day)
actions.value: The trapper sets a trap in a space within 5 feet of it. A creature that moves within 5 feet of the trap immediately sets it off, affecting each creature in a 5-foot radius centered on the trap. The trap can be one of the options listed for the Trapper's Crossbow or one of the following additional options:

entries: **Fire Trap**: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 12. *Failure:* The target has the Burning condition (1d8).
**Shock Trap**: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 12. *Failure:* The target has the Shocked condition until the end of its next turn.
**Frost Trap**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12. *Failure:* The target has the Frozen condition (DC 10).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The veteran makes two attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the end of the veteran's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Quarry
bonusActions.value: The veteran casts __Hunter's Mark__, using the spellcasting ability from Spellcasting.

bonusActions.name: Quick Ascent
bonusActions.value: The veteran moves up to 30 feet in a straight line in any direction, provided it ends its turn adjacent to a solid surface.

fluffInfo.value: *Mutated Experiment*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Hospital horrors have spent much of their existence being prodded with needles, so being pierced frays what few wits they retain.

entries: **Languages**: understands Common and Deep Speech but can't speak

traits.name: Aversion to Needles
traits.value: If the horror takes Piercing damage, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The horror has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the horror's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The horror makes two Graft Blade attacks.

actions.name: Graft Blade
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Stim Burst
bonusActions.value: The horror takes the Dash action and can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

entries: **HP**: 5 plus five times your Pugilist level (the hound has a number of Hit Dice [d8s] equal to your Pugilist level)

traits.name: Pack Bond
traits.value: Add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check or saving throw the beast makes.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* Bonus equals your Constitution modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* **2d4 + 2** plus your Constitution modifier Piercing damage. If the target is a creature Large or smaller, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC equals 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or one of the following effects of your choice occur: the target has the Grappled condition, it has the Prone condition, or it is pushed 5 feet away from the hound.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The bandit makes two attacks, using Scimitar and Pistol in any combination.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Pistol
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 30/90 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d10 + 3**) Piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *Cursed House Brought to Malevolent Life*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: While not haunted houses in the traditional sense, houses of horror can have their consciousness quelled by the same exorcism or purification rituals that put unquiet spirits to rest or drive out possessing spirits.

entries: **Immunities**: poison; exhaustion, grappled, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
**Languages**: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

traits.name: Construction
traits.value: Creatures can enter the house's space and navigate it as a normal building. The house makes attacks from any surface or object that isn't being worn or carried within its space. It doesn't have Disadvantage on ranged attack rolls due to an enemy being within 5 feet of it.

If a creature deals 30 or more damage in a single turn to a 5-foot section of the house's structure, the house must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or a 5-foot opening appears in that space until the start of the creature's next turn.

traits.name: Exorcism Susceptibility
traits.value: If the house is targeted by a __Dispel Evil and Good__ spell, it has the Stunned condition. At the end of each of its turns, it can make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw, ending the condition on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. As a Magic action, a creature inside the house that throws a flask of Holy Water against the house and succeeds on a DC 20 Charisma check affects the house as above.

traits.name: Soul Trap
traits.value: A Humanoid that dies within the house has its soul trapped there until the house dies. The creature can't be returned to life by any means short of a __True Resurrection__ or __Wish__ spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The house makes three attacks, using Structure Slam or Object Fling in any combination, and it uses Agonized Souls.

actions.name: Structure Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) Force damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). The house can grapple up to two creatures at a time, using animated furniture, objects, or fixtures such as stair railings.

actions.name: Object Fling
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +11, range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d4 + 6**) Bludgeoning or Piercing damage (house's choice). If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Agonized Souls
actions.value: The house's stolen souls torment a victim. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, a creature within 10 feet of the house. *Failure:* 36 (**8d8**) Necrotic damage. *Success* Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Alter Structure
bonusActions.value: The house can reshape itself to change the location of walls, doors, floors, and other features of its construction. When one of these features appears or disappears, a creature within 5 feet of a changing feature can make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature chooses which side of a feature it ends up on, or it moves to the nearest unoccupied space to avoid falling.

entries: **Skills**: deception +5, insight +4, investigation +5, perception +6, sleight of hand +4, stealth +6

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) Piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Poison damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 30/120 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d6 + 2**) Piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Poison damage.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.value: The spy takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

entries: **Senses**: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius unless Unleashed Eyes is active)

traits.name: Curse Dependent
traits.value: If the brute is targeted by a __Remove Curse__ spell or similar magic, until it finishes a Long Rest, the brute loses its Blindsight, its Withering Eye trait, and its Cursed Gaze action.

traits.name: Stimulant Rush
traits.value: At the start of its turn, the brute must choose one of the following options (it can't use that option twice in a row):

traits.name: Catalyst Infusion
traits.value: Until the start of its next turn, the brute's Speed increases to 50 feet, it doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it leaves an enemy's reach, and its Long Jump is up to 30 feet and its High Jump is up to 15 feet with or without a running start.

traits.name: Caustic Secretion
traits.value: Until the start of its next turn, its Fist attack deals an extra 11 (**2d10**) Acid damage (included in the Fist attack below).

traits.name: Stim Boost
traits.value: Gain 10 Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Unleashed Eyes (1/Day)
traits.value: When the brute is *Bloodied*, its sealed eyes rip open and unleash its curse. It is no longer blind beyond 60 feet, and it can use its Withering Eye trait and Cursed Gaze action until it finishes a Long Rest, whereupon its eyes seal shut again.

traits.name: Withering Eye (Unleashed Eyes Only)
traits.value: When the brute moves to within 5 feet of a creature, the creature takes 4 (**1d8**) Psychic damage. A creature takes this damage only once per turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The brute makes two Fist attacks and can use Cursed Gaze if available.

actions.name: Fist
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**1d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage. If Caustic Secretion is active, the target takes an extra 11 (**2d10**) Acid damage.

actions.name: Cursed Gaze (Unleashed Eyes Only)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 9 (**2d8**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the brute's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.value: *The only time I ever felt like a pincushion. Incredible speed and furiosity, if they weren't a machine-corpse enemy I'd be impressed.*

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study a Humongous Fungus Troll, learning the following information based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) From Harsh Environments
fluffInfo.value: You know the troll's Spore

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Hard to Kill
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the troll's Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Special Weakness
fluffInfo.value: You have insight into the troll's Vulnerabilities.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Humongous Fungus Trolls remain motionless and observe trespassers to see if they are a threat. If combat is initiated, the Humongous Fungus Troll uses its Grasping Tendrils to pull victims towards it, then use its Entangling Mycelia to entangle as many creatures as possible within its Rotting Aura.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Giant.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Guts, Flesh..

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Tentacles, Spores.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Bark.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Elemental Dust.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the troll remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a gigantic mushroom.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The troll regains 30 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Rotting Aura
traits.value: Any creature who starts its turn in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the troll takes 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage unless the troll has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: On its turn, the troll can move as normal
actions.value: However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the troll takes one of the following Epic Actions of its choice at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Spore Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 33 (**6d8 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Grasping Tendrils
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 60 ft. *Hit:* 22 (**3d10 + 6**) Slashing damage and if the target is Huge or smaller, the troll pulls the target up to 20 feet straight towards itself.

actions.name: Entangling Mycelia (Recharge when *Bloodied*)
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature of the troll's choice in a 30-foot radius centered on it. *Failure:* The target has the Restrained condition (save ends).

actions.name: Spawn Trolling (1/Round)
actions.value: The troll creates a Fungal Trolling which appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it. The fungal trolling acts immediately after the troll uses this action, then acts after the troll's turn on subsequent rounds.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The troll chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. A troll can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) check to Study a Hunter Hulk, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Stealthy Assassin
fluffInfo.value: You know of its Invisibility trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Hooked Arms
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Hulk's Lashing Tendrils attack and Reel Bonus Action.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Strong and Tough
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Hulk's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Hunter Hulks hide in the ruins of Drakkenheim, often Invisible, attempting to get the drop on their prey. Once the Hulk's target is in a prime position, it lunges out and whips its arms around them, pulling in the unfortunate target. The Hunter Hulk then devours them with its Belly Maw. If the creature breaks free, or if the Hunter Hulk is being too heavily damaged, it turns Invisible again and slinks back into the shadows. However, the Hunter Hulk will not so easily give up on its prey, and it may stalk the target and their party for a time, looking for a better moment to strike again. Sometimes it launches another ambush almost immediately, other times it will stalk them for several hours.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Tentacles, Teeth.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Hair.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hulk makes two Lashing Tendril attacks and one Belly Maw attack.

actions.name: Lashing Tendrils
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 60 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). The hulk can grapple up to two creatures at once.

actions.name: Belly Maw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**3d8 + 5**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.value: The hulk casts __Invisibility__ on itself, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spell-casting ability.

bonusActions.name: Reel
bonusActions.value: The hulk pulls each creature Grappled by it up to 25 feet straight toward it.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.value: While in Bright Light, the hunting horror has Disadvantage on attack rolls and checks.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The hunting horror has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hunting horror makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack, It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, Reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**2d10 + 6**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, Reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d8 + 6**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18).

bonusActions.name: Prey's Doom
bonusActions.value: The horror unravels a target's life force with a bite. The hunting horror studies one creature it can see within 30 feet of itself. For 1 minute, once on each of the hunting horror's turns when it hits the target with an attack roll using its Bite attack, it can cause the target to take an extra 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target can't regain Hit Points until the end of hunting horror's next turn. On each of the hunting horror's subsequent turns, it can take a Bonus Action to deal 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage to the target automatically.

This effect ends if the target is ever outside the range, if it has Total Cover from the hunting horror, if it is on a different plane of existence, or if hunting horror uses this Bonus Action on a different creature.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Nature*) checks when they Study a Hypnotic Eldritch Blossom, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Slow Moving Plant.
fluffInfo.value: You're aware of the plants movement, Resistances, and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Enchanted Blossoms.
fluffInfo.value: You learn of its Hypnotic Pollen action and Spell Reflection Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Tough and Unthinking.
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the blossom's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: These plants typically grow in places protected from easy access, such as a pool of contaminated water, and they weaponize their environment against threats. The blossom attempts to contaminate victims with its nectar and uses the surroundings to amplify the danger of contamination. The flower is not agile enough to escape attacks, and relies on its Hypnotic Pollen to keep itself alive. Hypnotized victims view the flower as an impossibly beautiful object and are lured into any nearby hazards.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Plant.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Sap.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Flowers.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Stem.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Spores.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Leaves.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Plant Dust.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the eldritch blossom remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary flower.

actions.name: Contaminated Touch
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 10. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level. If the target is Charmed by the eldritch blossom, it is hit automatically and has Disadvantage on its save.

actions.name: Hypnotic Pollen (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 10, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the eldritch blossom. *Failure:* The target has the Charmed condition for 1 minute. While Charmed, the target has the Incapacitated condition and must approach the eldritch blossom on its turns, taking the most direct path possible and moving through hazards. The effect ends early if a creature takes an action to shake the target out of its stupor.

fluffInfo.value: *Hungry Hypnotizing Wolf*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Hypnovulfen have no power to mesmerize anyone holding a keepsake or memento received from a loved one, as it overpowers the false beckoning of the monster's gaze.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The hypnovulfen has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hypnovulfen makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack, and it can use Swallow.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**2d10 + 7**) Piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Psychic damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d6 + 7**) Piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Psychic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 20, one Medium or smaller creature Grappled by the hypnovulfen (the hypnovulfen can have only one creature swallowed at a time). *Failure:* The hypnovulfen swallows the target, which is no longer Grappled. While swallowed, a creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the hypnovulfen, and takes 21 (**6d6**) Psychic damage at the start of each of the hypnovulfen's turns. If the creature dies from this damage, the hypnovulfen absorbs its memories and regains 25 Hit Points.

If the hypnovulfen takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the hypnovulfen must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 10 feet of the hypnovulfen and has the Prone condition. If the hypnovulfen dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

bonusActions.name: Hypnotic Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
bonusActions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 19, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. A creature holding a keepsake from a loved one succeeds automatically. *Failure:* The creature has the Charmed condition until it takes damage. While charmed, it has the Incapacitated condition and must move as close to the hypnovulfen as possible by the safest route. The creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study an Injector, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Impervious to Pain
fluffInfo.value: You understand the creature's damage and condition Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Be careful, it's volatile!.
fluffInfo.value: You know of its Unstable Tank Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Hardy Creature
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Injector's AC, Hit Points, and weakest ability score and saving throw.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: If the Injector has allies nearby, it uses Booster Dose to bolster them before combat. Otherwise, it ruthlessly attacks with its Syringe Arms. It feels no pain and does not waver or retreat.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Construct.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Chemical Solution.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts..

fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine.

fluffInfo.value: Needles.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Stitches.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin, Plates.

entries: **Languages**: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The injector makes four Syringe attacks. It can replace any number of attacks with uses of Booster Dose instead.

actions.name: Syringe
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d4 + 6**) Piercing damage, and the target is subjected to one of the following effects (roll 1d4; reroll if the injector has already used that effect during this turn):

entries: **Lethal Injection**: The target takes 21 (**6d6**) Poison damage.
**Numbing Solution**: The target takes 9 (**2d8**) Cold damage and is subjected to the following effect: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target has the Frozen condition (DC 16).

**Mind Dampener**: The target takes 7 (**2d6**) Psychic damage and is subjected to the following effect: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target has the Bewildered condition (save ends).

**Induced Necrosis**: The target takes 9 (**2d8**) Necrotic damage and is subjected to the following effect: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target has the Weakened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Booster Dose
actions.value: The injector administers a tincture to a Friendly creature it can see within 5 feet that isn't a Construct, choosing from the effects below. Once a creature benefits from a tincture, it can't gain that benefit again until it finishes a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Adrenaline Rush
actions.value: The target can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action or make one weapon attack with Advantage.

actions.name: Inoculation
actions.value: The injector chooses Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, or Poison damage. The target gains Resistance to the chosen damage type for 1 minute.

actions.name: Restorative Fluid
actions.value: The target regains 35 10d6 Hit Points. If the target is already at its Hit Point Maximum, it gains these as Temporary Hit Points instead.

actions.name: Focus
actions.value: The target has the Valor condition 1d4 for 1 minute.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study an Innocent Harvester, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Metal and Wood
fluffInfo.value: You understand the Innocent Harvester's creature type as well as its damage and condition Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (12+) Clamber and Leap
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Innocent Harvester's Leap.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Simple Construct
fluffInfo.value: You know the Innocent Harvester's mental saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Though small and innocent in appearance, Innocent Harvesters are not defenseless. They are fast and agile, equipped with surgical tools in place of one hand and a syringe in the other. Made to subdue trespassers, or remove body parts from corpses, these unflinching minions will not hesitate to leap atop targets. However, they are more comfortable hiding and fleeing than fighting. Their job is to collect body parts. If threatened, they leap onto a target and begin using their surgical tools on them. Harvesters attempt to sedate wounded targets and flee.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Construct.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Chemical Solution. Natural Weapons: Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Stitches.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Plates.

traits.name: Normal Semblance
traits.value: The harvester has Advantage on Charisma (*Deception*) and Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks to pass itself off as an ordinary Small Humanoid such as a Human urchin or a Halfling.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The harvester makes two Surgical Claw attacks.

actions.name: Surgical Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage, and the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4).

actions.name: Syringe (1/Day)
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Piercing damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 11. *Failure:* 28 (**8d6**) Poison damage. *Success* Half damage. *Failure or Success*: If this Poison damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it is stabilized but has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour, even if it regains Hit Points. While Poisoned, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Latch (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The harvester moves up to its Speed. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of a Medium or larger creature, it can make one Surgical Claw attack against that creature. *Hit:* The harvester attaches to the target. While attached, the harvester has Advantage on attack rolls against the target. The attached harvester moves with the target, using none of the harvester's movement. The harvester can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement on its turn. A creature within 5 feet, including the target, can take an action to detach the harvester with a successful DC 13 Strength (*Athletics*) check.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.value: The harvester takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The knight makes two attacks, using Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +2, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d10**) Piercing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Radiant damage.

traits.name: Dual Mind
traits.value: The inspired has Advantage on Wisdom saving throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The inspired makes two Crysteel Dagger attacks. It can replace one attack with __Vicious Mockery__.

actions.name: Crysteel Dagger
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) Piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Force damage.

fluffInfo.value: Within the Space Between Worlds, creatures exist that feed on arcane power, craving magic of all sorts, but particularly power that extraplanar patrons grant to mortals. One such creature identified by the Amethyst Academy has been classified simply as an Interloper.

fluffInfo.name: Drawn to Magic
fluffInfo.value: Interlopers crave magic, especially delighting in extracting the arcane power wielded by warlocks.
They latch onto the connection between a warlock and their patron, attempting to follow that connection into the Material plane where they lie in wait for their victim.

fluffInfo.name: Clustered Predators
fluffInfo.value: Interlopers seldom appear alone, preferring to attack in groups of three or more. Occasionally, they have been observed to bicker, fighting each other for the largest share of the spoils.

fluffInfo.name: Spell Snatchers
fluffInfo.value: Interlopers are feared by spellcasters because of their ability to Siphon Spells thrown at them. Once spellcasters recognize an area is infested with these creatures, they often commission Paladins of the Silver Order or grizzled monster hunters to hunt them down.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to study an Interloper, revealing the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Multidimensional Senses
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's Blindsight trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Magical Entity
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Siphon Spell ability.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Agile and Cunning
fluffInfo.value: You know the Interloper's highest and lowest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: An Interloper has only one objective, to feast on the spellcaster's magic that attracted it, and then to return to whence it came. It pursues the nearest spellcaster, prioritizing warlocks, assailing them until they are dead, or the caster's magic is spent It Teleports to evade physical attacks. If an Interloper drops below 10 Hit Points, it will __Plane Shift__, retreating into the Space Between Worlds to recover, seeking to return to feast again, likely in greater numbers.

fluffInfo.value: Claws.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The interloper is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The interloper may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the interloper can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the interloper has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The interloper is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the interloper's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: Interloper is immune to the Jinxed condition.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The interloper is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The interloper may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The interloper has Advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the interloper's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The interloper makes one Spindly Claw attack and one Suckered Bite attack. If the interloper has used Siphon Spell since the end of its last turn, it can instead make three Spindly Claw or Suckered Bite attacks.

actions.name: Spindly Claw
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 11, one creature within 5 ft. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage and the target gains one Contamination level. Succes: half damage only.

actions.name: Suckered Bite
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature within 5ft. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage and the target has the Bewildered condition (save ends) and the interloper regains 10 (3d6) Hit Points. *Success* half damage only.

actions.name: Delerium Healing
actions.value: The interloper touches a delerium shard and regains 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the interloper has used a delerium shard in this way, that shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

actions.name: Plane Shift (1/Day)
actions.value: The interloper casts __Plane Shift__ targeting only itself, requiring no components and using Charisma as its spellcasting ability.

bonusActions.name: Teleport
bonusActions.value: The interloper teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

fluffInfo.value: *Intruder From Beyond the Stars*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: The invaders have little resilience to the toxic and virulent threats of the Material Plane, and they succumb quickly to diseases and poisons.

traits.name: Alien Mind
traits.value: If a creature tries to read the intruder's mind or deals Psychic damage to it, that creature must succeed on a DC 16 Intelligence saving throw or have the Stunned condition for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Gliding Levitation
traits.value: The invader hovers 6 inches above the ground and leaves no tracks. It ignores Difficult Terrain caused by conditions on the ground, can move over liquids, and takes no damage from falling.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The invader has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Weak Constitution
traits.value: The invader has Disadvantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition. If the invader is Poisoned at the start of its turn, it takes 20 Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The invader makes three Disrupting Touch attacks and uses Unnerving Glare if available.

actions.name: Disrupting Touch
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) Force damage. A creature killed or an object destroyed by this damage is reduced to a fine gray dust.
Magic items, and any equipment worn or carried by a disintegrated creature, don't disintegrate.

actions.name: Unnerving Glare (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature the invader can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Incapacitated condition until the start of the invader's next turn.

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.value: The ghost can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ghost makes two Withering Touch attacks.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 19 (**3d10 + 3**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Horrific Visage
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 60-foot Cone that can see the ghost and isn't an Undead. *Failure:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the ghost's next turn. *Success* The target is immune to this ghost's Horrific Visage for 24 hours.

actions.name: Possession (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 13, one Humanoid the ghost can see within 5 feet. *Failure:* The target is possessed by the ghost; the ghost disappears, and the target has the Incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. The ghost can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Undead. The ghost's game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's Speed, as well as the target's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points or the ghost leaves as a Bonus Action. When the possession ends, the ghost appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours. *Success* The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours.

traits.name: Bloodied Frenzy
traits.value: While *Bloodied*, the berserker has Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**1d12 + 3**) Slashing damage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.value: The tough has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

fluffInfo.name: Changing Jonah's Attitude
fluffInfo.value: Suspicious by nature, Jonah is difficult to befriend. If characters talk with him about breaking the curse, he asks if they think whoever caused the curse was evil, or just misguided. His attitude increases one step to Friendly if they say they'll be sympathetic to the curse-maker or that they'll keep an eye out for Liza.
If they suggest that they'll kill the person who cursed Foxwillow, he becomes fearful and Hostile, refusing to speak at length.

fluffInfo.name: Jonah's Secret
fluffInfo.value: Jonah has harbored resentment for __William Lodge__ for years, though he no longer recalls why. By all accounts, William is well-liked and even sells livestock to the butcher. But Jonah recently discovered William had been selling him scrawnier stock than he sells to Siv Harga in Wickermoor Village, who pays a higher price for well-cared-for prize beasts.

In a fit of ire, Jonah slaughtered a lamb and invoked an old folk hex his grandmother once whispered about. He cursed William's fields and herds and—to his horror—the curse took root. Now, Foxwillow's crops and livestock wither—save for the demon-infested cornfield, which thrives unnaturally. Jonah, wracked with guilt, grows defensive, fearing the town's ruin rests on his shoulders.

fluffInfo.name: Learning His Secret
fluffInfo.value: As an Influence action, characters convince Jonah to reveal this secret with a successful DC 15 Charisma (*Intimidation* or *Persuasion*) check.

traits.name: Pack Tactics

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Survival* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) check to Study a Juggernaut Hulk, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Pure Destruction
fluffInfo.value: You know of its Out of My Way trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Rusted Blades
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Juggernaut's Whirlwind action and Rip and Tear Bonus Action.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Renewing Flesh
fluffInfo.value: You recognize its Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Juggernaut Hulk barrels forward in combat, slamming foes out of its way and swinging its blades wildly. Its main tactic is to knock enemies down and then drive its blades into them, bisecting them on the spot.
The Juggernaut Hulk does not flee and seems to shrug off most injuries. It will fight until its last breath with determination and ferocity.

traits.name: Regenerate
traits.value: The hulk regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If the hulk takes Acid or Cold damage, this trait doesn't function on the hulk's next turn. The hulk dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Out of My Way
traits.value: The hulk moves more than 10 feet in a straight line. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature within 5 feet of its path. *Failure:* The target is pushed 5 feet away from the hulk and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hulk makes two Rusty Blade attacks. It can replace one Rusty Blade attack with Whirlwind if available.

actions.name: Rusty Blade
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d6 + 6**) Slashing damage and the creature gains the Bleeding 2d6 condition.

actions.name: Whirlwind (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The hulk twirls its blades around it in a violent, heavy swing. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature within 10 feet of the hulk. *Failure:* 27 (**6d6 + 6**) Slashing damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Rip and Tear
bonusActions.value: The hulk makes one Rusty Blade attack against a Prone creature.

fluffInfo.value: *Laughing Lantern Bearer*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Kackles are bound to their lanterns, and smashing their lights can snuff out the spirits' existence.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The kackle can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Lantern Vulnerability
traits.value: The kackle's lantern has AC 15 and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. Any damage the lantern takes deals half that amount of Force damage to the kackle.

actions.name: Lantern Flame
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. *Hit:* Varies by lantern color (kackle's choice):

actions.name: Blue
actions.value: 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Cold damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Green
actions.value: 20 (**3d10 + 4**) Necrotic damage, and the target's Speed is 0 until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Purple
actions.value: 10 (**1d12 + 4**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Red
actions.value: 15 (**2d10 + 4**) Fire damage, and the target starts burning, taking 5 (**1d10**) Fire damage instead of the regular burning damage.

bonusActions.name: Flickering Teleport
bonusActions.value: The kackle teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The kackle can then change its lantern color, and it can create the following—*Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the kackle's destination space. *Failure:* 13 (**3d8**) damage of the same type as the current Lantern Flame color. *Success* Half damage.

fluffInfo.value: *Druid Transformed by Blight*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: The fungus growing throughout keepers of the blight empowers and sustains them, and killing that growth diminishes their power.

traits.name: Blight Dependent
traits.value: If the keeper is targeted by an effect that ends the Poisoned condition, it takes 10 (**3d6**) Force damage and has Disadvantage on D20 Tests until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Fungal Step
traits.value: The keeper ignores Difficult Terrain caused by plants or fungi.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The keeper makes two attacks, using Blight Staff or Spore Spray in any combination, and it uses Rotting Ritual.

actions.name: Blight Staff
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**1d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spore Spray
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**2d8**) Poison damage. If the target is a creature, it has the Poisoned condition until the end of the keeper's next turn.

actions.name: Rotting Ritual
actions.value: The keeper magically creates one of the following effects of its choice. It can't use the same effect twice in a row.

actions.name: Frenzying Spores
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, a creature the keeper can see within 30 feet. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target must immediately take a Reaction to make a melee or ranged attack against a creature of the keeper's choice that is within reach or range of the attack. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Blight Spawn
actions.value: The keeper magically summons a Rotweaver (lacks a Hunting Horn) in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of itself. The rotweaver takes its turn immediately after the keeper on the same Initiative count, and it obeys the keeper. The rotweaver vanishes after 1 minute, or when it or the keeper dies.

actions.name: Devouring Fungus
actions.value: Life-sapping fungus sprouts from the ground in a 60-foot radius centered on the keeper.
The area is Difficult Terrain, and a creature has the Poisoned condition while within the area. The fungus remains for 1 minute, until the keeper uses this effect again, or until it dies.

fluffInfo.value: *Voice-Stealing Trickster*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Ketgrinn can't resist a puzzle or riddle, and a difficult one can send a ketgrinn's mind spiraling.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The ketgrinn has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: The ketgrinn can mimic any voice it has heard, or a voice it has stolen (see Consume Voice below). A creature that hears the voice can tell it's an imitation with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (*Insight*) check. The DC increases to 19 for a voice the ketgrinn has stolen.

traits.name: Riddle Bound
traits.value: As an Influence action, a creature that poses a riddle to the ketgrinn and succeeds on a DC 16 Charisma (*Deception*) check gives the ketgrinn the Incapacitated condition until the start of the creature's next turn. Each riddle posed increases the DC for future riddles by 1 for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ketgrinn makes two Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Consume Voice.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Psychic damage, and if the target is a creature, it has Disadvantage on the next saving throw the ketgrinn forces it to make before the end of the ketgrinn's next turn.

actions.name: Consume Voice
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 14, one creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Psychic damage, and the ketgrinn steals the target's voice. The target can't speak or make any verbal sound while its voice is stolen.

The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If it fails three of these saving throws, the loss is permanent, and its voice only returns when the ketgrinn dies. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Teleport
bonusActions.value: The ketgrinn teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine*, *Arcana*, or *Survival* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study the Kingkiller Hydra, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Lab Construct
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's type, its Resistances, and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Barrage of Bites
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Hydra Fury Epic Action.

fluffInfo.name: (24+) Head Regrowth
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Multiple Heads trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Kingkiller Hydra is relentless. It attacks with all its heads against any target in range. If there is distance between it and its foes, it Tramples them before unleashing Bite attacks with its heads, or it Spits Acid at them from afar while closing the distance.
If the hydra takes 75 or more Fire damage in a single round, it attempts to flee.
