traits.name: Corrosive Aura
traits.value: The area within 30 feet of the hydra is filled with corrosive fumes and is Lightly Obscured. A creature that starts its turn in the fumes takes 20 (**8d4**) Acid damage.

traits.name: Head Count
traits.value: The hydra can't make more Bite or Spit Acid attacks each round than it has heads, and each head can only be used to make one Bite or Spit Acid attack each round.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.value: The hydra has five heads. Whenever the hydra takes 25 damage or more in a single turn, one of its heads dies. The hydra dies if all of its heads are dead.

traits.name: Reactive Heads
traits.value: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra Reaction that can be used only for Opportunity Attack action.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: The hydra is immune to the Burning (Acid only) condition.

traits.name: Wakeful
traits.value: While the hydra sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

actions.name: The hydra always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the hydra can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the hydra takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 20 ft. *Hit:* 26 (**4d8 + 8**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Spit Acid
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +14, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 20 (**8d4**) Acid damage, and the target has the Burning condition (8d4 Acid). While Burning, the target has the Blinded condition.

actions.name: Grow Heads
actions.value: The hydra can only perform this Epic Action if one or more of its heads died this round, unless the head was killed by Fire damage. The hydra grows two heads, and regains 20 Hit Points.

actions.name: Hydra Fury (1/Round)
actions.value: The hydra makes one Bite attack or one Spit Acid attack for each head that hasn't yet made an attack this round.

actions.name: Trample (1/Round)
actions.value: The hydra moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attack action. During this movement, it can move through the spaces of Huge or smaller creatures. Each creature the hydra moves over is subjected to the following effect. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 22. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Tail (1/Round)
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 34 (**4d12 + 8**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed up to 20 feet away from the hydra.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The hydra chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The hydra can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

traits.name: Aura of Righteousness
traits.value: Theodore projects a 30-foot Emanation of radiant power. Allies in the Emanation have Advantage on saving throws. A Hostile creature that starts its turn in the Emanation takes 14 (**4d6**) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Theodore always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, Theodore can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Theodore takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Holy Avenger Longsword**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +13, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 18 (**2d12 + 5**) Slashing damage, and the target suffers one of the following effects of Theodore's choice.
**Divine Smite**: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Radiant damage. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Searing Smite

fluffInfo.value: The creature is cloaked in dark rags that hang off their hunched form, two massive lanterns dangling from fleshy protrusions off their back. Their arms and legs are gangly and long, as though they walk on stilts as they lumber forward on all fours. Their face is expressionless and pale, with hollow black pools for eyes. As their mouth opens, their jaw unhinges to reveal a gaping maw filled with spiked, hooked teeth. The creature's screech is harrowing as lamps glow brighter and motes of arcane energy flit about them.

Before the cataclysm that claimed Drakkenheim, lamplighters would traverse the city's streets at dusk, ensuring all the lanterns along the main thoroughfares were lit. Once, those lanterns were guiding lights to those making their way home at the end of the day. Now, the contamination that spreads through Drakkenheim has transformed the former lamplighters into twisted abominations. Their forms have merged with the lanterns they once kept lit, letting them lure creatures in the ruins toward their comforting lights—then devour those creatures while they bask in the glow.

In their contaminated madness, lamplighters view other creatures as pests desiring to put out their lanterns, and so they have resolved to snuff out those creatures instead. One can sometimes hear the muttering and wailing of the lamplighters echoing these delusions, as they cry out, "Keep the lights!" or "Must not let the darkness in ..."

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Lamplighters hide in dark, ruined buildings or small hovels during the day, emerging only at dusk. They patrol through the night, magically lighting the ruined lanterns of the city to ensure that the main roads are well illuminated.

From a distance, a lamplighter appears as a softly glowing light that bobs as it moves through the ruins. The creature uses their Lantern Beams action to either fend off creatures from a distance, or to lure unsuspecting prey in toward them. When a creature is close enough, the lamplighter uses their ravening maw to attack and devour them.

A lamplighter reduced to below a quarter of their Hit Points usually attempts to flee into the ruins to recover. These creatures are territorial to the streets they worked in life, and they will return to that territory once healed, continuing to protect their precious lights against intruders.

Because lamplighters are inherently drawn to the dark places of Drakkenheim, characters can often avoid them by sticking to areas already illuminated by lantern light. At the same time, lamplighters can be drawn to specific locations by snuffing out the lights in the area along a main road, compelling the creatures to come and reignite their lanterns.

While Charmed in this way, the target must use all of their movement on their turns to move toward the lamplighter. The target has advantage on its saves to end this effect if it's taken damage from the lamplighter. After 1 minute, the target is no longer Charmed by the lamplighter.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Last Memories can move along the ground or up walls, often hiding as shadows on the ground. They have even followed prey, appearing as a strange movement in one's peripheral vision, or a shifting shadow from an unknown source.

When they reveal themselves, Last Memories cry out in anguish, causing those nearby to suffer visions of their last moments, inducing emotional trauma to any who succumb to it. They grasp those nearby, terrorizing them with waves of sorrow. Last Memories seem to embody the raw emotions of their death, using those emotions as weapons against the living. They do not flee, for they do not cherish their existence. Their only purpose is to spread the fear and the pain of their own death before fading away, only to reappear days later to relive their agony.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: A Living City takes the form of an oddly intact residence, workshop, or warehouse using its Structural Form trait, and waits for hapless creatures to wander inside. A Living City may deceive characters into entering it using its telepathy and Haunting Whispers. It suppresses its Digestive Aura and so it can take full advantage of its False Appearance trait.

Typically, a Living City shapes its body to create outer rooms that have walls bordering the edge of the Living City's space, and inner rooms deep within which do not have walls, ceilings, or floors immediately adjacent to spaces outside the Living City. The Living City will create doors, windows, or even stairs within it so that its prey can easily move from outside, to the outer rooms, and then further inside to the inner rooms. Often, the Living City might place any treasure or valuables it has collected in these inner rooms as bait.

Once a few characters have entered one of its innermost rooms, the Living City attacks and activates its Digestive Aura. When it rolls Initiative, it uses its No Exit trait to close all the doors and windows in its body, trapping characters inside. Then, it attacks them with its Grasping Tendrils, Bite, and Haunting Whispers, while using its Shifting Form Epic Action to slowly change its interior, separating the characters and cutting off their escape routes.

Should the player characters break a hole in one of its walls, the Living City uses its Shifting Form trait to plug the hole. Note that some area-of-effect attacks and spells (such as __Burning Hands__) can damage or destroy multiple sections of the Living City. However, a Living City can only take damage from one section being destroyed per turn. If characters manage to slip outside the Living City through a breached hole or exit, the Living City may use its Grasping Tendrils to pull them back in. It then tries to quickly seal them inside again with Shifting Form.

traits.name: Digestive Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn in the living city's space takes 10 (**4d4**) Acid damage. At the start of its turn, the living city decides whether its Digestive Aura is active until the start of its next turn (no action required).

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.value: While the living city remains motionless in its Structural Form, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary structure or vehicle, such as a house or a sailing ship.

traits.name: Structural Form
traits.value: The living city can spend 10 minutes in *Concentration* to shape-shift into a Gargantuan structure or back into its true, amorphous form. Its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

While in the form of a structure, the living city takes up its entire space and creates floors, walls, doorways, and windows within its space which resemble and behave like normal structures, while leaving behind open space within it to create rooms. Creatures can pass through the open spaces and stop there as if moving through a normal structure.

The walls and floors of the living city can be damaged and thus breached. Each 5-foot-by-5-foot section has AC 15 and 30 Hit Points. Reducing a section to 0 Hit Points destroys it and deals 30 damage to the living city. A living city can only take this damage once per turn.

In addition, the living city extrudes pieces of itself inside its space which resemble furnishings and everyday objects. The extrusions appear, feel, sound, and behave exactly like the mimicked objects. A thin, slimy tendril connects any furnishings or objects to the body of the living city. The tendril has AC 15 and 1 Hit Point. If the tether is severed or destroyed, the simulacra melts into goo, but does no harm to the living city.

traits.name: No Exit
traits.value: When it rolls for Initiative, the living city reflexively closes the windows, doors, and other egress points on the outside of its body, preventing creatures inside it from leaving its space.

A creature in the living city's space that attempts to leave its space using teleportation or planar travel is subjected to the following effect. *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 20. *Failure:* 27 (**5d10**) Psychic damage. *Failure or Success*: The teleportation or planar travel fails.

actions.name: The living city always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the living city can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the living city takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 0 ft. *Hit:* 23 (**4d8 + 5**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Grasping Tendril
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**2d8 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed or pulled 10 feet (the living city's choice).

actions.name: Haunting Whispers
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature in the living city's space. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Shifting Form
actions.value: The living city alters the composition of a 10-foot-by-10-foot area inside it, creating walls, doors, windows, stairs, or furnishings. It can choose to make the area Difficult Terrain. Creatures inside the living city who are not directly observing the shift must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom (*Perception*) check to notice the change.

If the living city creates a wall that cuts through another creature's space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (the living city's choice). If a creature would be surrounded on all sides by the wall (or the wall and another solid surface), that creature can make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it can use its Reaction to move up to its speed so that it is no longer enclosed by the wall.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The living city chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The living city can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: When it encounters an uncontaminated creature, the Living Deep Haze rapidly moves into its space thanks to its Fog Form trait. It then tries to remain there as much as possible so the creature is exposed to its Deep Haze trait. The Living Deep Haze wants to transform its targets into monsters, so it uses its Slam attacks to knock them Unconscious so they can awaken to a new existence as mutant horrors.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Loathsome Gag Fly is a simple-minded creature who wants to feed on flesh and lay larva on the corpses of the dead. It sprays acid on any creature that it sees nearby in an attempt to weaken it. It then lands on them and begins feeding.

Gag Flies usually attack in groups and care very little for the wellbeing of each other. As a matter of fact, when a Gag Fly is killed and explodes in a shower of acid, this usually causes other nearby flies to go into a feeding frenzy on targets sprayed in the gore, as they are drawn to any flesh dissolving in the acids of their mucus.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Lob Frogs are keen to keep their distance from predators and threats, but are constantly on the lookout for hosts for their offspring. They attempt to lob their contaminated eggs at potential threats, hoping to produce more Lob Frogs. If confronted directly, their Poison Skin acts as a defense while they use their Standing Leap to escape unfavorable situations.

If a Lob Frog has at least two or more targets with attached eggs, or if they are reduced below half Hit Points, they leap away to find somewhere safe and wet to hide. They would rather not risk their life, and simply hope to infect as many targets as possible to continue their species.

actions.name: Throw Frogspawn
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 30/60 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d8 + 2**) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Acid damage. If the target is a creature, the egg sticks to the target's body, melding with its flesh. A creature within 5 feet of the egg can take an action to remove the egg, dealing 10 (**3d6**) Acid damage to the target in the process. If the egg is still attached to the target at the end of its next turn, the target is infected with a disease and has the Sickened condition until the disease ends. The disease can't be cured except by magic.

Every hour, the target is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level. Contamination levels gained in this way can't be removed until the disease is cured. If the target suffers a Monstrous Transformation, it dies and its flesh falls away, birthing a Lob Frog.

traits.name: Intimidating Aura
traits.value: Elias projects a 30-foot Emanation of imposing command. An ally that start its turn in the Emanation has Advantage on the first attack roll it makes before the start of its next turn. A Hostile creature that starts its turn in the Emenation takes 10 (**3d6**) Thunder damage and is subjected to the following effect. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. *Success* The target is immune to Elias's Intimidating Aura for 24 hours.

actions.name: Elias always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, Elias can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Elias takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Lord Commander's Blade**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 25 (**4d8 + 7**) Slashing damage, and Elias can apply one of the following martial masteries to the target:
**Wound**: The target has the Bleeding condition (4d4).
**Topple**: The target has the Prone condition.
**Sap**: The target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of start of Elias's next turn.
**Longbow**: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +12, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 25 (**4d8 + 7**) Piercing damage, and Elias can apply one of the following martial masteries to the target:
**Push**: If the target is Large or smaller, it is pushed up to 10 feet away from Elias.
**Slow**: The target has the Slowed condition (DC 15 Constitution save ends).

actions.name: Command
actions.value: Elias chooses one ally he can see. If the ally can see and hear him, it can use its Reaction to make one weapon attack with Advantage. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 10 (**3d6**) damage.

actions.name: Flare (1/Round)
actions.value: Elias chooses a point he can see within 60 feet and fires at flare at it, signaling the Hooded Lantern's bombardment. Elias recharges his Artillery Strike. He can only use this Epic Action if it's the first Epic Action he has taken this round.

actions.name: Artillery Strike (Recharge Special)
actions.value: Elias can only use this Epic Action if it's the last Epic Action he takes this round. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 20-foot radius Sphere centered on the point Elias chose with his Flare Epic Action. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Piercing damage plus 14 (**4d6**) Fire damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Epic Resistance

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Lord of the Feast stalks the Temple Ward of Drakkenheim with his war dogs, searching for glorious kills. He seeks out the most fearsome monsters, and loves picking fights with faction agents and adventurers. When a band of plucky heroes enters his territory, the Lord of the Feast tracks and hunts them until they leave the Inner City or he has their skulls.
The Lord of the Feast uses a variety of arrows in combat:
Poison Arrow to debilitate foes, Ensnaring Arrow to stop them fleeing, and Harpoon Arrow to pull them toward him to engage in melee combat.
If the Lord of the Feast is reduced below 100 Hit Points, he attempts to escape, but regroups as soon as possible with more hunters in tow to continue the hunt.

entries: **Bite**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level.

actions.name: Call of the Hunt (1/Round)
actions.value: The Lord of the Feast releases a blood-curdling howl that can be heard all across Drakkenheim. All garmyr in the city heed this call and rush towards the Lord of the Feast's current position. Each garmyr within 60 feet who can see and hear the Lord of the Feast can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed and make one melee or ranged attack with Advantage.

actions.name: Epic Resistance

traits.name: Holy Aura
traits.value: Lucretia projects a 60-foot Emanation of holy power. At the start of each of her turns, she can choose the aura's effect, which applies to creatures of her choice in the Emanation:

traits.name: Divine Grace
traits.value: Creatures in the Emanation that target Lucretia with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell. This effect doesn't protect Lucretia from area effects, such as the explosion of a __Fireball__. If Lucretia makes an attack, casts a spell that affects an enemy, or deals damage to another creature, this trait ends until the start of her next turn.

traits.name: Pacifying Presence
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation has the Weakened condition until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Wrathful Flame
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation takes 10 (**3d6**) Radiant damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Fire damage.

traits.name: Prescient
traits.value: Lucretia can't be *surprised* while she is conscious.

traits.name: Sanctified by Falling Fire
traits.value: When Lucretia dies, her soul is pulled into the delerium crystal embedded in her chest.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: Lucretia Mathias is immune to the Contamination condition.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.value: While Lucretia is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, her AC includes her Wisdom modifier (included above).

traits.name: Undeniable Faith
traits.value: Lucretia automatically succeeds on Constitution saving throws to maintain *Concentration* on her spells.

actions.name: Lucretia always takes her turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On her turn, Lucretia can use her movement and interaction as normal. However, she does not take an action or Bonus Action on her turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Lucretia takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Pacifying Touch**: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 20, one creature within 5 feet of Lucretia. *Failure:* 35 (**10d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only. *Failure or Success*: If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target is stabilized but has the Unconscious condition for 1 hour, even after regaining Hit Points.

**Sacred Flame**: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 20, one creature within 60 feet of Lucretia. *Failure:* 45 (**10d8**) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Divine Intervention (1/Day)
actions.value: Lucretia chooses any spell which doesn't require a Reaction to cast. As part of this Epic Action, she casts that spell without Material components. If she uses this Epic Action to cast the __Wish__ spell, she can't use this Epic Action for the next 1d4 days.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Lucretia chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting her and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on her. Lucretia can use this action even if she would otherwise be unable to take actions, her actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters her game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: *Thing That Goes Bump in the Night*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Frightened children know that lurkers in the dark can be held at bay by clutching a beloved stuffed animal.

traits.name: Nightmarish Contortion
traits.value: The lurker can fit into a space as small as a 1-foot Cube and can pass through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The lurker can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Ward of Innocence
traits.value: The lurker can't attack or willingly move to a space within 10 feet of a creature holding a stuffed animal once owned by a child.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lurker makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**1d10 + 4**) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two claws. Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition.

bonusActions.name: Dark Teleport
bonusActions.value: While the lurker isn't in Bright Light, it teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. If the destination space isn't in Bright Light, the lurker doesn't need to see it. A creature the lurker is grappling must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or teleport with the lurker to an unoccupied space closest to the lurker's destination.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine a Lurker on the Threshold, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Baleful Resistance
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Arcane Beams
fluffInfo.value: You learn the creature's Cosmic Rays attack action.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Enduring
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's highest and lowest ability scores.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Lurker on the Threshold is a creature of pure arcane energy and twisted realities. It fires Cosmic Rays at mortal creatures,warping their minds, showing truths that drive them mad, or undoes their very existence on a cellular level. It grabs creatures with its Tendrils and blasts its beams while holding them in place, undoing the creatures from the inside out, before tossing them aside and moving on to the next. The Lurker on the Threshold only flees if it is reduced to under half its Hit Points, not because of any sense of fear, but because it finds specific enemies a nuisance.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The lurker is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The lurker may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the lurker can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the lurker has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The lurker is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the lurker's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Eldritch Blood
traits.value: A creature that deals Piercing or Slashing damage to the lurker while within 5 feet of it takes 5 (**1d10**) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The lurker has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The lurker makes three Tendril attacks. It can replace each Tendril attack with a use of Cosmic Rays.

actions.name: Tendril
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 30 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition. The lurker has ten tendrils, each of which can grapple one creature.

actions.name: Cosmic Rays
actions.value: The lurker randomly shoots one of the following magical rays at a target it can see within 120 feet (roll 1d4; reroll if the lurker has already used that ray this turn):

entries: **Disintegrating Ray**: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 27 (**6d8**) Force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it disintegrates into dust.

**Memory Lapse Ray**: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* The target's memories become distant for 1 minute. While its memories are distant, the target can't take the Magic action, use class features, or understand language, and has Disadvantage on ability checks. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
**Contaminating Ray**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 16 (**3d10**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level. *Success* Half damage only.
**Existential Dread Ray**: On the target's next turn, each time it takes an action other than the Dodge action, moves more than 5 feet, or takes a Bonus Action, it takes 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Some Lurking Dregs hide in the shadows, waiting for an opportune moment to strike. Others pose as human and attempt to converse with prey, hoping to draw them deeper into the ruins. Lurking Dregs have been known to use stories of lost allies, trapped children, and more to lure adventurers into an ambush.

When they attack, Lurking Dregs use their Furious Ambush right away to get as many attacks in as possible. They Disengage if they can and attempt to keep their enemies at bay, possibly having other Dregs tie them up while the Lurking Dreg darts in and out.
If Lurking Dregs find themselves outnumbered at any point, they run into the shadows and Hide, attempting to escape.

fluffInfo.name: Changing Martha's Attitude
fluffInfo.value: Despite the horrors occurring at her doorstep, Martha is easy to befriend. She becomes immediately Friendly if they save __Jonah__ from death in the "The Burning Mill" encounter. Otherwise, she is Indifferent.

Her attitude increases one step if the characters demonstrate selfless heroism or emotional tenderness. Her attitude decreases one step if they are selfish or try to Influence her to learn a secret from her and fail their Charisma check.

fluffInfo.name: Martha's Secret
fluffInfo.value: Farmer Malachai, Martha's husband, was a violent drunk, and Martha accidentally killed him while defending herself. She has kept this secret ever since to protect her children.

fluffInfo.name: Learning Her Secret

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Maw Vermin is a primal creature that cannot comprehend anything beyond its next meal. Ratlings give them a wide berth, as it is just as likely to consume them as anything else. When a Maw Vermin senses anything it can eat, it lumbers towards the meal, using its Grasping Maw to pull targets closer so it can Bite them. Maw Vermin want to consume anything in sight, using its own food to secure even more. It uses Glob Launcher to spit half-digested morsels, happily eating whatever mess is left over.

A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and has Total Cover from effects originating outside the maw vermin. At the start of each of the maw vermin's turns, a swallowed creature takes 10 (**3d6**) Acid damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain one Contamination level.

The maw vermin can swallow up to three creatures at a time. If the maw vermin takes 20+ damage in a single turn from a creature inside it, the maw vermin must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which land in spaces within 10 feet of the maw vermin with the Prone condition. If the maw vermin dies, a swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.

While Burning, the target has the Restrained condition.

fluffInfo.value: A meld is formed from the faded souls of mortals—husks whose memories have been consumed by Dolurrh. These husks are typically harmless, but sometimes an aggressive nucleus gathers other husks, forming a deadly gestalt. In essence, a meld is a fusion of half-formed ghosts; it has an amorphous shape, with vague faces and limbs projecting from the mass, then being consumed once more. It makes no sound when it moves, but mortals around a meld hear cries of pain, pleading voices, and unearthly moans. Its Conflicted Soul action reflects it projecting some of its husks into a mortal body, temporarily overwhelming the victim with conflicting desires and visions.

fluffInfo.name: Denizens of Dolurrh
fluffInfo.value: Melds are born in Dolurrh, and prowl the endless caverns searching for scraps of memory. This hunger can draw them to Eberron through manifest zones or when planes are coterminous. A meld can also manifest when someone is raised from the dead, following in the wake of the soul being drawn back to the world of the living. Melds that enter Eberron rarely stray more than a mile from the point where they arrived.

fluffInfo.name: Hunger for Memory
fluffInfo.value: A meld has the barest traces of dozens of souls. It remembers scraps of the most powerful moments of its component husks, but it can't place these in any context. The meld yearns to consume other spirits, to feast on their memories and emotions. While highly unusual, it's possible for a powerful personality within a meld to exert temporary control; this might cause the meld to pursue a particular individual or draw it to a specific location. When a meld kills a living creature and consumes its spirit, the flood of memories can also shift the purpose of the meld, as it suddenly acts on the desires of its most recent victim. A meld loose in Eberron retains the spirits it consumes, preventing them from transitioning to Dolurrh. This prevents the spirit from fading; a character could hear the whispers of a trapped spirit within a meld, and a meld could hold the souls of people who died long ago. A side effect of this is that creatures slain by a meld cannot be resurrected or raised from the dead until the meld is destroyed.

fluffInfo.value: A stormcaller feels the flow of the tides around, currents below, and shifting storms above the water, and can direct this power against those who threaten their people. Working together, a circle of stormcallers can bring down an entire fleet of ships. The greatest stormcallers have powers beyond what's shown here; the merfolk tell stories of stormcallers who can command the beasts of the sea and transform into mighty squids or whales.

fluffInfo.name: Wardens of the Water
fluffInfo.value: Most stormcallers seek to maintain balance within their realm. Like the Wardens of the Wood, they strive to protect their region from outside threats, but also to protect foolish outsiders from the dangers of the deeps and the manifest zones the stormcallers guard. However, there are stormcallers who view any intrusion into their waters as an affront that must be punished.

fluffInfo.name: Druidic Speech
fluffInfo.value: Stormcallers know the Druidic language, which they believe to be the language of the world itself. Most stormcallers will parley with any creature who speaks Druidic, but they have high expectations of such beings. A stormcaller may ask a foreign druid to help with an unnatural threat or to serve as a mediator in a local dispute.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Summon Storm
traits.value: Once per day, one or more merfolk stormcallers can cast __Control Weather__ as a Ritual that takes 10 minutes to perform. For every additional stormcaller involved in performing the Ritual, the radius of the spell's effect increases by 1 mile, the duration increases by 2 hours, and they can change the weather by one additional stage every 1d4 x 10 minutes. During the casting, if the stormcallers take any action other than performing the Ritual, they must start over.

The specimen is specifically chosen for the knowledge it can provide to the mi-go, allowing it to adapt to a variety of situations. The mi-go chooses one of the following benefits: It gains Advantage on attack rolls until the end of its turn.
It uses the Dodge action as part of this Bonus Action.
It gains a +2 bonus to its spell save DC until the end of its turn.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Minazorond is an animated engine of destruction charged with the protection of Castle Drakken. The corrupted protector attacks any who approach the palace itself, opening with a terrifying roar and a barrage of shocking bursts before closing the distance to unleash its breath weapon. Under most circumstances, the dragon is too large to physically enter the palace proper, and is thus restricted to attacking targets in the castle baileys and courtyards.

traits.name: Protective Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of Minazorond takes 14 (**4d6**) Lightning damage.

traits.name: Construct Resilience
traits.value: If damage reduces Minazorond to 0 Hit Points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken, unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a success, Minazorond drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

actions.name: Minazorond always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, Minazorond can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, Minazorond takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bite**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 33 (**4d12 + 7**) Piercing damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.
**Claw**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**3d6 + 7**) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 22, one creature Minazorond can see within 20 feet. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Force damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Shocking Burst
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 20, one target Minazorond can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 22 (**4d10**) Lightning damage, and the target has the Shocked condition. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Terrifying Roar (Recharges after a Short Rest)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 20, each creature in a 120-foot Emanation originating from Minazorond that can hear it. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Thunder damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Breathe Deep (1/Round)
actions.value: Minazorond's Breath Weapon recharges. Minazorond can only use this Epic Action if it's the first Epic Action it has taken this round.

actions.name: Breath Weapon (Special Recharge)
actions.value: Minazorond uses one of the following breath weapons. It can only use this Epic Action if it's the last Epic Action it takes this round.

actions.name: Lightning Breath
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 22, each creature in a 120-foot Cone. *Failure:* 81 (**16d8**) Lightning damage, and the target has the Shocked condition. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Thunder Breath
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 22, each creature in a 120-foot Cone. *Failure:* 66 (**12d10**) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet away from Minazorond and has the Dazed condition (save ends). Failure by 5 or More: Double damage, and the target also has the Deafened condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: Minazorond chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. Minazorond can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

traits.name: Aquatic Camouflage
traits.value: The leech has Advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to hide in aquatic terrain.

traits.name: Memory Bank
traits.value: The leech has three memory banks in its body. When encountered, roll 1d3 to determine how many memory banks are filled with grey matter. The rest are empty.

actions.name: Attach
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 0 ft. *Hit:* The leech attaches to the target. While attached, the leech doesn't attack, and moves with the target, using none of the leech's movement. The leech can detach itself using 5 feet of movement, and detaches immediately if its blood bags are filled or if the target dies.

A creature within 5 feet can take an action to detach the leech with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (*Medicine*) check. *Failure:* The leech is still detached, but the target has the Bleeding condition (2d4). Failure by 5 or More: The leech isn't detached and the target takes 8 (**2d4 + 3**) Piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Brain Drain
bonusActions.value: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature. That creature is subjected to the following effect. *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 11. *Failure:* The target's Intelligence score is reduced by 1d4, and one of the leech's memory banks is filled. If this effect reduces the target's Intelligence score to 0, it has the Unconscious condition until it regains at least 1 point of Intelligence. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the creature finishes a Short or Long Rest.

bonusActions.name: Thought Transfusion
bonusActions.value: The leech can use this Bonus Action only when it is attached to a creature and has at least one filled memory bank. The attached creature gains Advantage on Intelligence-based D20 Tests for 1 minute, and the leech empties one of its filled memory banks.

If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16) from the Mind Siphon's Tentacle Tongue, and the target has the Stunned condition until the Grapple ends. The Mind Siphon can Grapple up to two creatures at the same time.

actions.name: Consume Head (Recharge 6)

fluffInfo.value: *She doesn't look so tough, now surrender before you...uh oh*

A Mutagenist has researched a serum that they inject to transform into a monstrous form. They use themselves as the conduit for this power and hurl themselves towards their enemies as a hulking abomination. They spend their lives researching and discovering new ways to improve and modify the serum in hopes of becoming the perfect Apex form.

fluffInfo.name: Mutagenist Minions
fluffInfo.value: The Mutagenist is constantly experimenting on other creatures before turning their concoctions onto themselves. First their tests involve small rodents, birds, or other unassuming livestock. Skinwings are one such example of a Mutagenist's early experimentation. When they move on to humanoid subjects, they create abominations like the __Cerebrograft__, while their failed experiments end up as Uncontained Growths.

Every Mutagenist strives to accomplish the ultimate goal of the Apex Formula, the elixir that will transmogrify them into the perfect specimen of humanity, at least in their altered and maddened view.

entries: **Personality Trait:** I bury myself in books and research, and seldom talk to others.
**Bond:** My work is important, with my research I could cure so many of humanity's inherent weaknesses, and make us stronger as a species.
**Ideal:** Perfection is achievable if one just puts the time and effort into obtaining it.
**Flaw:** I know my view of the perfect human is flawless, I will not hear otherwise..

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Physiological Experts
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Mutagenist's saving throws, as well as the Grotesque Gargantuan's Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Forced Mutation
fluffInfo.value: You learn of its Mutant Strain and Transmogrifying Elixir action.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Hulking Form
fluffInfo.value: You know of the Transmogrified Form's Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Mutagenist relies on their spellcasting and Forced Mutation, attempting to cause debilitating effects on its foes while altering their forms.

If the Mutagenist is in a losing situation, it drinks its Transmogrifying Elixir to become its Transmogrified Form. In this form, it hurls rocks at its targets, knocking them Prone. The hulking Mutagenist then bounds up to them and slams them with its Meaty Fists.

traits.name: Noxious Blood
traits.value: When a creature hits the mutagenist with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it, the creature takes 10 (**3d6**) Poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Scalpel

The mutation lasts for 1 minute, and afterwards, any lost body parts are restored. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Transmogrifying Elixir (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)

bonusActions.name: Anatomical Precision

fluffInfo.name: Secret

traits.name: Anchoring Mask

If the nurse starts its turn and isn't wearing its mask, it must move as far as possible to retrieve its mask if possible, or to reach the closest creature it can see or hear, and it must attack that creature. If it can't see or hear any other creatures, it either stands still and does nothing, or it destroys any objects in its vicinity (50 percent chance of either).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The nurse makes two Stab attacks. If it hits a creature with a Stab attack, it can use Inject if available.

Failure by 5 or More: The Poisoned target also has the Unconscious condition until it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it awake. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Mutation

entries: **Cerebral Graft**: Part of a psionic creature's brain is grafted to the nurse's own. *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature within 30 feet. *Failure:* 11 (**2d10**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of its next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

**Tentacle Lash**: A tentacle writhes beneath the nurse's skin or clothes. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success* Half damage only.

Creatures swallowed by the necrolisk can't pass through it using Incorporeal Movement or through the Ethereal Plane, and creatures can't teleport out of its stomach.

While swallowed, the creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the necrolisk, and takes 21 (**6d6**) Force damage at the start of each of the necrolisk's turns.

If the necrolisk takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the necrolisk must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 10 feet of the necrolisk and has the Prone condition. If the necrolisk dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

traits.value: When Nyarlathotep drops to 0 Hit Points or would be killed outright, he is not slain. Instead, his body ripples with energy as it undergoes a horrific transformation. He returns to whatever strange realm he dwells in as his defeated form is torn apart by unseen forces. Mythos creatures with a combined CR of up to 20 emerge from the pile of gore, occupying the nearest, empty space. These creatures attack those who were hostile to Nyarlathotep and fight to the death.

traits.value: If Nyarlathotep fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance

traits.name: Poisoned Words, Rotten Soul

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Octarine Tree grows in clusters within Queen's Park Garden, or in the forests north of Drakkenheim, but lone trees have been spotted in advantageous positions throughout the city. Whether in market squares or growing on cliff sides overlooking parts of the city, the trees seem to keep watch over large stretches of road. The Octarine Tree is surprisingly fast when it decides to move but usually opts to root itself in a good position and throw Delerium Fruit at its enemies.

When engaged in melee, an Octarine Tree tangles up creatures in its Crushing Roots and Thwacks them. It will take an opportunity to lumber to a better position and plant itself in the ground to continue hurling fruit if it can.

While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition. The octarine tree can grapple up to four creatures at a time.

actions.name: Delerium Fruit

Failure by 5 or More: The target triggers an [Arcane Anomalies](https://5e.tools/tables.html#arcane%20anomalies_monstersofdrakkenheim) centered on itself.

bonusActions.name: Take Root
bonusActions.value: If the octarine tree has not moved this round, it can plant itself into the ground. It regains 18 (4d8) Hit Points and has the Immobilized condition until the start of its next turn. While Immobilized, the octarine tree has Immunity to the Grappled, Prone, and Restrained conditions, and its AC increases to 20. These benefits end early if the tree takes Fire damage.

traits.name: Bloodied Frenzy
traits.value: While *Bloodied*, the berserker has Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**1d12 + 3**) Slashing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *Devout Follower of Old Gods*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Old Ways chosen bind their power into a mask they use as a focus. Without the mask, their magic unravels.

traits.name: Animal Mask
traits.value: The chosen wears the mask of an animal, imbuing it with the strength of the old gods. When a creature is grappling the chosen, the creature can remove the mask as an action, or as an attack during the Attack action, with a successful DC 12 Strength (*Athletics*) check. Without its mask, the chosen can't cast spells, its *Concentration* on any existing spells ends, and the save DC of Song of the Old Ways is reduced by 4.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The chosen makes three Ritual Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Ritual Dagger
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d4 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Radiant or Necrotic damage (the chosen's choice).

actions.name: Songs of the Old Ways (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The chosen sings one of the following songs:

actions.name: Blessing of the Harvest
actions.value: Each creature of the chosen's choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the chosen regains 14 (4d4 + 4) Hit Points.

actions.name: Song of Sacrifice
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 14, one creature within 30 feet. *Failure:* 40 (**9d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of the chosen's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Wicker Chant
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature of the chosen's choice in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the chosen. *Failure:* 31 (**9d6**) Fire damage. *Success* Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Jump (Requires Animal Mask)
bonusActions.value: The chosen casts __Jump__, using the same spell components and spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Religion* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study an Oracle of the Rat God, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Divinely Resistant
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Oracle of the Rat God's Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Fiendish Foresight
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the oracle's Death Toll and Squeak of Doom actions, as well as its Tail Barbs Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Aware and Commanding
fluffInfo.value: You know the Oracle of the Rat God's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: These revered figures are seldom encountered alone. Instead, they are often in the company of several Swarms of Ratlings and perhaps even borne aloft on a litter by a squadron of Giant Ratlings. They may even have several Warlocks of the Rat God serving them as underlings. These minions are disposable to the oracle, who commands their underlings to throw themselves against their foes with wild abandon.

In battle, a ratling oracle fights from the back, calling out proclamations of doom on their foes using Death Toll and Squeak of Doom. They mock their foes' attempts at any success, attempting to use Tail Barbs to turn an opponent's luck against them.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart, Brain, Guts, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Skull, Spine, Ribs.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Claws, Teeth.

fluffInfo.name: Hair:
fluffInfo.value: Fur.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The ratling has Advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Death Toll
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature the ratling can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 45 (**10d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Weakened condition (save ends). *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Squeak of Doom (1/Day)
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 16, each Hostile creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the ratling that can hear it. *Failure:* 55 (**10d10**) Psychic damage. *Success* Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Ratling Cunning
bonusActions.value: The ratling takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

traits.name: Training
traits.value: The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the DM's choice and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) Bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* or *Religion* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study the Pale Man, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Unnatural Resilience.
fluffInfo.value: You learn the Pale Man's monster type, Resistances, and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Fear Incarnate.
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the Pale Man's Terror Gaze action.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Predator's Precision.
fluffInfo.value: You know the Pale Man's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Pale Man is a consummate ambush predator. He prefers to stalk prey from concealment, sowing paranoia before striking. He uses his Terror Gaze to incapacitate or scatter groups, then isolates and eliminates targets one by one.

If pressed into open combat, he uses his unnatural agility to slip away, often retreating into darkness or vanishing from sight entirely, only to resume his hunt moments later. He never fights to the death unless cornered, and even then, he uses every trick at his disposal to escape.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity or Undead (uncertain).

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Heart.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Claws.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

entries: **Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained

traits.name: Aura of Fleshy Insects
traits.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature of the Pale Man's choosing who starts its turn within 60 feet of the Pale Man. *Failure:* 22 (**5d8**) Necrotic damage and the target gains one level of Contamination.

traits.name: Crawling Flesh
traits.value: When the Pale Man is reduced to 0 Hit Points, he breaks apart into a __Swarm of Contaminated Insects__ in the same space. Unless the swarm is destroyed, the Pale Man's swarm returns to its cocoon and reforms into the Pale Man 1d6 days later.

traits.name: Insect Body
traits.value: The Pale Man can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the Pale Man can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect.

actions.name: The Pale Man always takes his turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On his turn, the Pale Man can use his movement and interaction as normal. However, he does not take an action or Bonus Action on his turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the Pale Man takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn.

actions.name: Contaminating Touch
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18. *Failure:* The target gains one level of Contamination.

actions.name: Forced Mutation
actions.value: The Pale Man targets a creature within 60 feet who has one or more mutations and magically alters the mutation. The Pale Man chooses one of the target's existing mutations to remove and replaces it with a different one of his choice.

actions.name: Infest the Flesh (1/Round)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation from the Pale Man. *Failure:* 22 (**5d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains the Burning (3d8 Necrotic) condition. A target also has the Dazed condition while it is burning in this way. Failure by 5 or more: The target also has the Restrained condition (save ends) due to masses of swarming fleshy bugs. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Contaminate (1/Round)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature Restrained by the Pale Man's Infest the Flesh action. *Failure:* The target gains one level of Contamination.

actions.name: Abrupt Contaminant (1/Round)
actions.value: The Pale Man targets a creature within 60 feet who has one or more levels of Contamination. That creature takes 7 (**2d6**) Necrotic damage for each level of Contamination it has.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The Pale Man chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting him and rolls 1d20. On an 11 or higher, the effect ends on him. The Pale Man can use this Epic Action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

fluffInfo.value: *Pro tip, go for the eyes before it goes for your blood.*

The study of diseases opens doorways to many dangerous scientific discoveries. As experts in both ridding the body of illness and the mutations of infectious disease, a Pathogenist brings their study to the battlefield by using monsters and enemies as test subjects for their infections. Long years spent carefully monitoring the causes and effects of such plagues has led to a mastery of disease mutation. A Pathogenist's creations can spread in a terrifying manner, riddling their foes with debilitating symptoms, crippling their bodies and rattling their minds.

fluffInfo.name: Pathogenist Minions
fluffInfo.value: An __Injector__ makes a great lab assistant for the Pathogenist, helping it administer disease and pathogens to its victims. __Wretched Patients__ are often disease-ridden, bandaged individuals who are convinced that, if they aid the doctor, they will be cured. __Plague Carriers__ are a common unfortunate product of a Pathogenist's experiments, used to deliver disease to its enemies in grotesque fashion.

entries: **Personality Trait:** I love my pathogens and viruses, and speak to my babies as if they were my children.
**Bond:** Understanding the fine balance between what it takes to harm or heal is vital to the ongoing progression of modern medicine.
**Ideal:** Disease is often feared and misunderstood, but with understanding, comes control. You do not need to fear that which you control
**Flaw:** I am bound to my work and cannot fathom the idea that I am misguided in my research..

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Pathogenist, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Poison Master
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Pathogenist's Resistances and Immunities as well as its Heightened
Tolerance trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Disease Experimenter
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Pestilent Infection and Outbreak actions.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Lacks Character
fluffInfo.value: You know the Pathogenist's Strength and Charisma ability modifiers and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Pathogenist uses poison and disease to disable their foes. When combat begins, they attempt to inflict Plague of Wind upon a target, and proceed to use Outbreak to spread that disease. The Pathogenist uses Poison Needle to subdue problematic targets. The Pathogenist will attempt to flee if they have fewer than 40 Hit Points and are outnumbered.

traits.name: Laboratory Adaptation
traits.value: The pathogenist is immune to disease.

traits.name: Mutated Strains
traits.value: The pathogenist's attacks and effects ignore the target's __Resistance__ or Immunity to Poison damage and Immunity to the Poisoned condition and disease.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The pathogenist makes two Poison Needle attacks.

actions.name: Poison Needle
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d4 + 3**) Piercing damage plus 35 (**10d6**) Poison damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, it is stabilized and has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour, even if it regains Hit Points. While Poisoned, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

actions.name: Pestilent Infection (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The pathogenist infects one creature it can see within 30 feet with a magical disease. At the start of each of its turns, the target is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Necrotic damage, and the target gaines one Exhaustion level. Third Success: The disease ends.

actions.name: Plague Wind (1/Day)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. *Failure:* 22 (**5d8**) Poison damage plus 23 (**5d8**) Necrotic damage. *Success* Half damage. *Failure or Success*: If the target has 25 Hit Points or fewer after taking this damage, it dies and its flesh turns to ash, leaving a weathered skeleton.

bonusActions.name: Heightened Tolerance
bonusActions.value: The pathogenist ends the Charmed or Frightened condition on itself.

traits.name: Fear of Canines
traits.value: If the familiar can see a dog, wolf, or other canine at the start of its turn, it has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. While Frightened in this way, it has Disadvantage on saving throws.

traits.name: Flyby (Pigeon Only)
traits.value: The familiar doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Vermin Telepathy
traits.value: The familiar can magically control Beasts and swarms that match its incarnation (centipedes, pigeons, weasels, giant versions of each, as well as __Boogleswarms__, __Skitterswarms__, and __Squabswarms__) within 120 feet of itself, using a special telepathy.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The familiar makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Incarnated Assault (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The familiar uses the option that matches its incarnation.

actions.name: Terrifying Flutter (Pigeon Only)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 12, one creature the familiar can see within 5 feet. *Failure:* 21 (**6d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of the familiar's next turn. The Frightened target uses its movement on its turn to get as far away as possible from the familiar, moving by the safest route. *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Insight* and *Investigation* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they examine a Phage, revealing the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Interdimensional Intruder
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of its Warped Space trait.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Magic Eater
fluffInfo.value: You understand its Consume Spell Reaction and Bite attack.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Stored Energy
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Phage's Spell Vessel trait.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Phages are compelled by their hunger for magic. They use their Consume Spell Reaction at the first opportunity, regardless of the spell being cast.

Unfed phages stalk their prey, harassing them with Bites but attacking nonlethally as a dead spellcaster cannot provide them with magical energy. Sated phages often become docile, only using Bite or Spit in defense, disengaging to escape if given the opportunity. When their lives are threatened, Phages digest stored spells to reposition in hopes of getting an even tastier morsel.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor.

fluffInfo.name: Bones:
fluffInfo.value: Baleen.

fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

traits.name: Spell Vessel
traits.value: After using its Consume Spell Reaction, the phage stores the spell until the spell is digested or the phage dies. When the phage dies, the spell takes effect. If the original caster of the spell sees the phage die, it can choose the area or target(s) of the spell as if they had cast it from the phage's space. Otherwise, the spell affects a random area or target(s) from those within range.

traits.name: Warped Space
traits.value: The phage magically warps space in a 10-foot Emanation. Attacks targeting the phage from outside the Emanation have Disadvantage, and the phage has Advantage on saving throws against spells and effects that originate from outside the Emanation.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Piercing damage. If the phage isn't storing a spell, it makes this attack with Advantage and deals an extra 14 (**4d6**) Piercing damage on a hit.

actions.name: Spit
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 60/120 ft. *Hit:* 14 (**3d6 + 3**) Acid damage.

actions.name: Digest Spell
actions.value: The phage digests the spell it has stored, teleporting to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet and making a Spit attack with Advantage.

fluffInfo.value: *Ghostly Coach of the Dead*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Phantom hearses are driven to collect the living, and they can't see a living creature that holds its breath.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder
**Immunities**: necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Breathless Warding
traits.value: A creature holding its breath has the Invisible condition to the hearse. If the creature takes damage while holding its breath, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or let out its breath and become visible to the hearse until the start of the creature's next turn, when it can hold its breath again.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The hearse can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hearse makes two Ghostly Coachman attacks. It can replace one of the attacks with a use of Trample, if available.

actions.name: Ghostly Coachman
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft. *Hit:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Cold damage. If the target is a creature, it can't regain Hit Points until the start of the hearse's next turn.

actions.name: Trample (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The hearse moves in a straight line up to its Speed. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature whose space the hearse enters during this action. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Cold damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends. *Success* Half damage only.

actions.name: Tolling Bell (1/Day)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature of the hearse's choice that it can see in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the hearse. *Failure:* 44 (**8d10**) Psychic damage, and the creature's Speed is halved until the start of the hearse's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Entomb
bonusActions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature Grappled by the hearse (it can have up to three creatures entombed at a time). *Failure:* The target is entombed in a coffin in the hearse, and the Grappled condition ends.

An entombed target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the hearse, and at the start of each of the hearse's turns it takes 21 (**6d6**) Necrotic damage and gains 1 Exhaustion level.

If the hearse takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside a coffin, the hearse must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or release all entombed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the hearse and has the Prone condition. If the hearse dies, any entombed creature falls to the ground with the Prone condition in the hearse's former space.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (**1d8 + 1**) Piercing damage.

fluffInfo.value: *Vermin Hag of Deception and Control*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: The vanity of a pigeon hag is so overwhelming that polishing its ego can leave it flustered and briefly unable to act.

entries: **Skills**: deception +11, insight +9, perception +9, sleight of hand +7

traits.name: Disarming Vanity
traits.value: As an Influence action, a creature that flatters the hag forces it to succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw or have the Incapacitated condition until the end of the hag's next turn.

traits.name: Harrying Wings
traits.value: When the hag rolls Initiative, it is surrounded by fey spirits in the form of angry pigeons.
The hag's enemies within a 10-foot Emanation originating from it have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls. This trait doesn't function if the hag has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hag makes three Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting (at will spells only).

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 12 (**2d6 + 5**) Slashing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Agonizing Cackle (1/Day)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 19, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. *Failure:* A target takes 45 (**10d8**) Psychic damage and has the Incapacitated condition until the start of the hag's next turn. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.value: The hag shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

traits.name: Unshakeable Faith (1/Day)
traits.value: When the pilgrim would fail a saving throw, it can reroll the save with Advantage. It must use the new roll.

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (**1d6 + 1**) Bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* or *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Plague Carrier, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Multiple Disease Carrier
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the Plague Carrier can carry Fatigue, Coughing Fits, and Shivers.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Dangerously Infectious
fluffInfo.value: You know of the creature's Bile Spreader action.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Plague Carrier is a vile creature whose sole purpose is to spread its infection. It runs into a crowds and use its Bile Spreader to infect as many targets as possible, resorting to biting any who get too close. It cares little for its own safety and does not retreat

fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.value: Monster Blood, Contaminated Ichor, Acidic Bile.
