fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Religion* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study a Warlock of the Rat God, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Otherworldly Pact
fluffInfo.value: You are aware these creatures have an excellent sense of smell, Darkvision, are capable climbers and swimmers and this ratling's damage Resistances.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Potent Spellcasting
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the ratling's Balefire and Conjure Swarms actions.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Commanding but Frail
fluffInfo.value: You know the ratling's strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: A Warlock of the Rat God does everything in its power to put "lesser" ratlings between it and its enemies. They deem themselves far too valuable to be put in harm's way, but are also inherently overconfident in their powers, convinced the Rat God protects them from harm.

A Warlock of the Rat God will have likely cast __Mage Armor__ on itself prior to rolling Initiative, as most keep this spell active when venturing out of their burrow, or at the first sign of danger. They conjure a Swarm of Rats to pester their enemies, and use Balefire to pummel their foes. When their defenses are exhausted they cast __Invisibility__ on themselves and attempt to flee using __Teleport__.

fluffInfo.value: Monstrosity.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.value: The ratling has Advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (**1d4 + 2**) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Balefire
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**4d8 + 3**) Necrotic damage, and the target has the Burning condition (2d8 Necrotic).

actions.name: Conjure Swarms (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.value: The ratling conjures two Swarms of Rats, which appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet. The swarms act immediately after the ratling in Initiative. The swarms remain for 1 minute or until destroyed.

bonusActions.name: Teleport
bonusActions.value: The ratling teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *History* or *Nature* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks when they take the Study action to examine a Warp Marauder, learning the following based on the result.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Mentally Tough
fluffInfo.value: You learn the creature's Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Reality Distortion
fluffInfo.value: You are aware of the creature's Swirling Color Field trait.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Strong and Nimble
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's highest and lowest ability scores.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: The Warp Marauder has control over the reality around it. It grabs creatures and drags them into extraplanar realities where it feeds on them. The lupine alien isn't afraid to be hit, relying on its ability to alter time and space from an incoming attack, directing an essence of chaotic circumstance back towards the creature.
Warp Marauders flee if they are reduced below half their Hit Points.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Aberration.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Contaminated Ichor, Goopy Ooze, Mucus.

fluffInfo.name: Organs:
fluffInfo.value: Eyes, Guts, Glands, Flesh.

fluffInfo.name: Natural Weapons:
fluffInfo.value: Tentacles, Teeth.

fluffInfo.name: Hide:
fluffInfo.value: Skin.

fluffInfo.name: Dust:
fluffInfo.value: Aberrant Dust.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The warp marauder is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The warp marauder may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the warp marauder can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the warp marauder has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The warp marauder is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the warp marauder's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Extraplanar Gullet
traits.value: The warp marauder's back opens into a large mouth that leads to an extradimensional gullet. Anything it swallows is transported into this extraplanar space, which manifests as a rhizomatic network of slurping tunnels and fleshy passages. This space can hold any number of creatures of any size, and nothing inside the space can harm the warp marauder.

A creature within the gullet can take an action to attempt to escape, making a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On a success, it reappears in the nearest unoccupied space within 5 feet of the warp marauder. On a failure, it takes 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage. If the warp marauder dies, everything inside the extraplanar gullet appears in the nearest unoccupied spaces to its corpse.

traits.name: Grasping Tentacles
traits.value: The warp marauder can have up to four tentacles at a time. Each tentacle has AC 20, 10 Hit Points, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. Destroying a tentacle deals no damage to the warp marauder, which can extrude a replacement tentacle on its next turn. A creature within 5 feet can take an action to break a tentacle with a successful DC 15 Strength check.

traits.name: Swirling Color Field
traits.value: A field of shimmering color reverberates around the warp marauder, distorting reality. A creature that hits the warp marauder with an attack suffers one of the following effects, determined randomly (roll 1d6). A creature Grappled and adjacent to the warp marauder isn't affected by the Swirling Color Field.

traits.name: 1-2: Blue
traits.value: The attacker is teleported to an unoccupied space the warp marauder can see within 20 feet. The chosen space must be on a surface or in a liquid that can support the target. The attacker is then subjected to the following effect. *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* The target has the Immobilized condition (save ends).

traits.name: 3-4: Yellow
traits.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* 21 (**6d6**) Lightning damage. *Success* Half damage.

traits.name: 5-6: Red
traits.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* The target has the Staggered condition (save ends).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The warp marauder makes four Tentacle attacks, uses Reel, and makes one Bite attack.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 60 ft. *Hit:* The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition and has Disadvantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and the warp marauder can't use this tentacle against another target.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft, one creature Grappled by the warp marauder. *Hit:* 16 (**2d10 + 5**) Piercing damage, and the warp marauder swallows the target. The target, along with everything it is wearing and carrying, appears in the warp marauder's Extraplanar Gullet.

actions.name: Reel
actions.value: The warp marauder pulls each creature Grappled by it up to 30 feet straight toward it.

bonusActions.name: Dimensional Jump
bonusActions.value: The warp marauder teleports to an unoccupied space within 120 feet. Alternatively, it travels from the Material Plane to the Space Between Worlds or vice versa.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Religion*) checks to Study a Warp Witch, learning the following based on their result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) Resistant Undead
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the Warp Witch's Resistances and Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Mutative Control
fluffInfo.value: You recongize the creature's Possession action and Mutate Host Bonus Action, but not the means to end the possession.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Escaping Possession
fluffInfo.value: You are aware that the Warp Witch's Possession can be ended by reducing the possessed body to 0 Hit Points, or by casting __Dispel Evil and Good__.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: A Warp Witch begins combat by using its Psychic Scream. The witch then selects a target amongst their foes to possess.

While possessing a host, the Warp Witch will try to use the body to deceive or trick allies of its host into not attacking or harming them, trying to suggest useless, ineffective, and halfmad courses of action to "help" the host "drive out" the spirit, such whistling, dancing, clapping, singing, drawing pictures, and other bizarre commands. Meanwhile, the witch continues to use Mutate Host to contaminate them. The Warp Witch leaves the host after they undergo a Monstrous Transformation, and then moves to repeat the process with another.

fluffInfo.name: Animus:
fluffInfo.value: Undead.

fluffInfo.name: Fluid:
fluffInfo.value: Ectoplasm.

fluffInfo.value: Hair.

fluffInfo.value: Undead Dust.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, bludgeoning, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder
**Immunities**: cold, necrotic, poison; charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
**Languages**: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The warp witch can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Balefire Lantern
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 21 (**4d8 + 3**) Cold damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the end of the warp witch's next turn.

actions.name: Psychic Scream
actions.value: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition (save ends).

actions.name: Possession
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 13, one Humanoid the warp witch can see within 5 feet. *Failure:* The target is possessed by the Warp Witch. The witch disappears, and the target has the Incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. The witch controls the target's body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The witch can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead. The witch retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions. It otherwise uses the possessed target's game statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points, the witch ends it as a Bonus Action, or the witch is turned or forced out by an effect like the __Dispel Evil and Good__ spell. When the possession ends, the witch reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. If the target succeeds on its save or the effect ends for it, it is immune to this warp witch's Possession for 24 hours.

bonusActions.name: Mutate Host
bonusActions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature the warp witch is possessing. *Failure:* The target gains one Contamination level and a mutation.

entries: **Skills**: deception +5, insight +5, intimidation +5, perception +5, persuasion +5, religion +3
**Languages**: one regional language plus one other language

traits.name: Enraging Sacrifice
traits.value: When the priest dies, each ally within 20 feet who can see the priest gains 10 Temporary Hit Points and a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls for 1 minute.

traits.name: Zealous Aura
traits.value: The priest radiates an aura of zeal in a 20-foot Emanation originating from it. Each ally in the area has Advantage on Initiative checks, and their successful attacks deal an extra **1d4** Radiant damage. This aura becomes inactive if the priest has the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The priest makes two Castigating Word attacks.

actions.name: Castigating Word
actions.value: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. *Hit:* 7 (**2d6**) Radiant damage, and one ally of the priest within 20 feet of the target can take a Reaction to make a melee attack.

bonusActions.name: Righteous Morale (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: The priest chooses up to three other creatures it can see within 20 feet of it. Each target regains 4 (**1d8**) Hit Points and has Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions until the start of the priest's next turn.

fluffInfo.value: *Lost Soul Bound to Regret*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Wayward haints can be trapped in empty bottles if they're tricked or forced to pass over one.

entries: **Resistances**: acid, bludgeoning, cold, fire, lightning, piercing, slashing, thunder
**Immunities**: poison; charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Bottle Trap
traits.value: A haint that enters the space of an upright, empty bottle must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be drawn into the bottle, and a cork or stopper appears to close the bottle. The trapped haint can see and hear through the bottle out to 10 feet, and any creature in that range can hear the haint. The haint is released if the bottle breaks or another creature opens it.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The haint can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if it ends its turn inside a solid object.

actions.name: Draining Regret
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage, and the target gains 1 Exhaustion level. This can't raise the target's Exhaustion level above 5, and all Exhaustion levels gained from this action end when the target finishes a Short or Long Rest, or if it receives a __Lesser Restoration__ spell or similar magic.

fluffInfo.value: *Hag of Soul Twisting and Terror*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Weasel hags' love of teeth goes beyond a mere quirk. They can't refuse a tooth willingly given by its owner and can't harm the owner for a time.

traits.name: Biting Gift
traits.value: If a creature willingly offers one of its teeth to the hag, the hag must accept it and has the Charmed condition for 24 hours, or until the creature or its allies deal damage to the hag or force it to make a saving throw.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The hag has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The hag makes one Bite attack and uses Spellcasting (at will spells only).

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 10 (**3d6**) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Waking Terrors (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature the hag can see within 30 feet. If the hag has one of the target's teeth, the target has Disadavantage on the save. *Failure:* 21 (**6d6**) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition.

While Frightened in this way, the target perceives its allies as enemies born from its nightmares, but it isn't compelled to act against or harm them. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.value: The hag shape-shifts to resemble a Tiny __weasel__ (Speed 30 ft., Climb 30 ft.) or a Small or Medium Humanoid, or back into her true form. Her game statistics, other than her Speed as a weasel and her size, are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

traits.name: Alluring Cry
traits.value: The cry of the Weeping Willow attracts creatures in a 120-foot Emanation from the willow. At the start of each of its turns, a creature within the area must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma save or have the Charmed condition for 1 hour. On a success, the target is immune to this Weeping Willow's Alluring Cry for 24 hours.

While Charmed, the target also has the Incapacitated condition. On each of its turns, a Charmed creature must use its movement to approach the Weeping Willow by the most direct route, stopping when it is within 5 feet of the Weeping Willow. It doesn't avoid Opportunity Attacks, but if this movement would obviously cause damage (such as by walking through fire), the creature repeats the save before entering that space.

traits.name: Deep Rooted
traits.value: The Weeping Willow is immune to effects that would move it.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The Weeping Willow has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The Weeping Willow makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack:* +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 25 (**4d10 + 3**) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Lignify
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* , one creature within 5 feet: DC 17. *Failure:* The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. *Failure:* The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition, becoming a tree permanently. __Greater Restoration__ or similar magic returns an affected creature to their original form.

fluffInfo.value: *Serpent Lurking Beneath the Surface*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: The sound of a hunting horn drives wellwyrms into a panicked frenzy.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.value: The wellwyrm can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Hunting Terror
traits.value: If the wellwyrm hears a creature play a horn or similar Musical Instrument, it has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The wellwyrm makes one Bite attack and uses Constrict.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 15 (**2d10 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 21 (**6d6**) Poison damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.value: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 16, one Medium or smaller creature the wellwyrm can see within 5 feet. *Failure:* 13 (**2d8 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends. The wellwyrm needn't spend extra movement to move during this grapple.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The priest makes two attacks, using Mace or Radiant Flame in any combination.

actions.name: Mace
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (**2d4**) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Flame
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d10**) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Flame
actions.value: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d10**) Radiant damage.

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Water can extinguish the undying flames of wildpyres, despite their ephemeral existence.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.value: The wildpyre can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (**1d10**) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Quenching Water
traits.value: Any water affects the wildpyre as if it were Holy Water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The wildpyre makes two Blazing Rend attacks and uses Flame Bind if available.

actions.name: Blazing Rend
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Necrotic damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Fire damage, and the target begins burning. If the target is a creature no larger than the wildpyre, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Flame Bind (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature the wildpyre can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Restrained condition. At the end of each of the target's turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. During the target's turn, it can choose to end the Restrained condition by taking 6 (**1d12**) Fire damage plus 6 (**1d12**) Necrotic damage.

fluffInfo.name: Changing William's Attitude
fluffInfo.value: Though Indifferent toward the characters when they meet him, his attitude increases one step to Friendly if they agree to join him in saving Foxwillow. His attitude decreases one step to Hostile if they intentionally cause destruction or loot the town (such as looting the statue in area J2) but increases one step if they take action to help (such as putting out fires when the town is burning).

His attitude increases one step if the characters demonstrate selfless heroism or emotional tenderness. His attitude decreases one step if they are selfish or try to Influence him to learn a secret from him and fail their Charisma check.

fluffInfo.name: William's Secret
fluffInfo.value: Though unmarried himself, William had an affair with another farmer's wife, __Martha Langtree__, who soon had a son with him. This son is the middle Langtree child, Isaac.

fluffInfo.name: Learning His Secret
fluffInfo.value: As an Influence action, a character convinces William to reveal this secret with a successful DC 15 Charisma (*Intimidation* or *Persuasion*) check.

traits.name: Training
traits.value: The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the DM's choice and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

actions.name: Club
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 2 (**1d4**) Bludgeoning damage.

fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Nature* or *Survival* gain Advantage on Intelligence (*Arcana*) checks to Study a Winter Troll, learning the following information based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (5+) From Harsh Environments
fluffInfo.value: You know the troll's Immunities.

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Hard to Kill
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the troll's Regeneration trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Special Weakness
fluffInfo.value: You have insight into the troll's Vulnerabilities.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Winter Trolls hunt for food during heavy snowfall and long winters. Often accompanied by swirling snowstorms and freezing temperatures, they begin combat by unleashing their Freezing Breath before rushing in to maul foes with their Slams and Bites.
If a Winter Troll takes Fire damage, it immediately flees and attempts to find a safe place to recuperate.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The troll regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Special Immunities
traits.value: The troll is Immune to the Frozen condition(s).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The troll makes two Slam attacks and one Bite attack. It can replace its Bite attack with Freezing Breath, if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Piercing damage plus 9 (**2d8**) Cold damage, and the target has the Slowed condition until the end of the troll's next turn. Critical *Hit:* The target has the Frozen condition (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Slam
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (**2d6 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (**2d8**) Cold damage.

actions.name: Freezing Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Cold damage and has the Frozen condition (escape DC 16). *Success* Half damage only.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: The ketgrinn has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.value: The ketgrinn can mimic any voice it has heard, or a voice it has stolen (see Consume Voice below). A creature that hears the voice can tell it's an imitation with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (*Insight*) check. The DC increases to 19 for a voice the ketgrinn has stolen.

traits.name: Riddle Bound
traits.value: As an Influence action, a creature that poses a riddle to the ketgrinn and succeeds on a DC 16 Charisma (*Deception*) check gives the ketgrinn the Incapacitated condition until the start of the creature's next turn. Each riddle posed increases the DC for future riddles by 1 for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The ketgrinn makes two Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Consume Voice.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (**2d4 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Psychic damage, and if the target is a creature, it has Disadvantage on the next saving throw the ketgrinn forces it to make before the end of the ketgrinn's next turn.

actions.name: Consume Voice
actions.value: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 14, one creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* 18 (**4d8**) Psychic damage, and the ketgrinn steals the target's voice. The target can't speak or make any verbal sound while its voice is stolen.

The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If it fails three of these saving throws, the loss is permanent, and its voice only returns when the ketgrinn dies. *Success* Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Teleport
bonusActions.value: The ketgrinn teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

fluffInfo.value: *Helper Made of Twine and Twigs (Ruby wrapped in a wicker cage)*

entries: **Immunities**: poison; deafened, exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

actions.name: Cursed Scratch
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (**1d6 + 3**) Piercing damage plus 3 (**1d6**) Necrotic damage, and if the target is a creature, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of the witchwoven's next turn.

fluffInfo.value: *Facsimile Grown of Root and Vine*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Woodwarped possess a deep fear of axes—tools capable of severing not only their bodies but their bond to the forest. The mere sight of an axe is enough to hold the creatures at bay, and the bite of its blade slices them like smoke.

traits.name: Aversion to Axes
traits.value: At the start of the woodwarped's turn, if it can see a creature holding a Battleaxe, a Greataxe, or a Handaxe, it has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Thorns
traits.value: At the start of each of its turns, the woodwarped deals 5 (**2d4**) Piercing damage to any creature it is grappling or any creature grappling it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The woodwarped makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Poison damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two claws.

actions.name: Thorn Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the woodwarped, with Disadvantage if Grappled by it. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. *Success* Half damage only.

fluffInfo.value: *Parasitical Physician*

fluffInfo.name: Secret
fluffInfo.value: Wormhost surgeons are drawn to seek out and infest sapient victims, so intelligent creatures with veiled minds slip beneath the surgeons' notice.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The surgeon regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If it takes Poison damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The surgeon dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Veiled Ignorance
traits.value: A creature whose mind can't be read, or that is under the effect of a __Mind Blank__ or __Nondetection__ spell, has the Invisible condition toward the surgeon (this ignores the surgeon's Blindsight).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The surgeon makes two Bone Saw attacks.

actions.name: Bone Saw
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d6 + 4**) Slashing damage plus 4 (**1d8**) Psychic damage.
Critical *Hit:* If the target is a creature, its Intelligence score decreases by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces that score to 0.

actions.name: Infested Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: The surgeon unleashes a spray of worm-ridden cerebral fluid. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 20-foot Cone. *Failure:* 17 (**5d6**) Psychic damage, and the target is infested with larval parasitic worms. The target takes 7 (**2d6**) Psychic damage at the end of each of its turns as the worms burrow toward its brain. The ongoing damage ends when the target takes Poison damage or is targeted by an effect that ends the Poisoned condition. *Success* Half damage only. *Failure or Success*: If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this Psychic damage, the worms reach its brain and it dies. A Humanoid slain in this way rises 24 hours later as a wormhost surgeon.

actions.name: Grasping Strike
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Punch Down
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (**1d8 + 4**) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

bonusActions.name: Brace Up
bonusActions.value: The wrestler gains 9 (2d8) Temporary Hit Points.

bonusActions.name: Combo
bonusActions.value: The wrestler makes one Grasping Strike or Punch Down attack.

fluffInfo.value: Magic is beyond the means of most commonfolk in the continent. Few can afford the services of the Amethyst Academy, and priests of the Sacred Flame and Old Gods alike are selective with their divine magic, offering their boons to devout worshippers or those in dire need only. However, apothecaries are seldom so selective, especially those who operate in remote regions or clandestinely within large cities.

fluffInfo.name: Desperate Vanity
fluffInfo.value: Lesser nobles and vain merchants occasionally seek out apothecaries not for a cure to an ailment, injury, or sickness, but in the hopes of augmenting some quality of themselves they find deficient. These individuals may come to an apothecary looking for a miraculous means to become taller or more comely, reverse aging, or even gain supernatural or magical abilities.

fluffInfo.name: Medical Malpractice
fluffInfo.value: Unfortunately for their patients, unscrupulous apothecaries may be perfectly willing to offer an experimental method or untested procedure in exchange for an affordable price, seeking an opportunity to trial their latest concoction upon a hapless yet willing subject. When these ill-conceived techniques inevitably go awry, the subjects find themselves transformed into a grotesque mockery of themselves.

fluffInfo.name: Promised Cure
fluffInfo.value: The transformation leaves the patient half-mad. Some are manipulated in the hopes of being cured one day, or tricked into believing that they must remain in the care of their "doctor" until they have "recovered" from the procedure. Many lash out in rage, fleeing into the wilderness, back alleys, or hidden away in their homes. Those unable to return to their former lives in fear or shame may remain, however.

fluffInfo.name: Useful Lackeys
fluffInfo.value: Left without the means to restore their former appearance, these wretched patients accept roles as orderlies, guards, and assistants to the apothecary responsible for their tormented contention. Truly psychotic apothecaries may increase their control over their patients through invasive brain surgery, chemical conditioning, and forced indoctrination. These terrible procedures render these unfortunate individuals fiercely loyal to the apothecary, imbuing them with a fanatical drive to protect them even at the cost of their own lives.

fluffInfo.name: The Varied Victims of Many Malpractices
fluffInfo.value: Wretched Patients represent the unfortunate victims of apothecaries' experiments. No matter their area of study, the deranged minds of evil scientists know no bounds with their experimentation on willing subjects in the name of occult science.

fluffInfo.name: Alienist
fluffInfo.value: Often those with mental instability or muddled minds turn to an Alienist. These patients are rendered into mindless and obedient servants through mind control, mental conditioning, and mind-altering procedures. Alienists have been known to go as far as remove portions of their victims' brains or remove their brains entirely while keeping the subject alive.

fluffInfo.name: Chemist
fluffInfo.value: Those looking for tinctures and tonics to ease all manner of ailments have turned to Chemists, often unaware of the danger of their compounds. These patients are often subject to new experimental procedures that leave them burned, or scarred, disfigured by chemical research. In some cases, the chemical procedures can leave the victims hairless, blind, or cause their skin to muddle and scar over completely.

fluffInfo.name: Exorcist
fluffInfo.value: An Exorcists patients seek help with possessions that may or may not be real. These haunted people can find themselves at the hands of mad scientist and spiritualist who will use the willing patient to summon or trap demonic forces. Sometimes these patients are simply what remains after a demonic or spiritual possession, where after the removal, the victim is left numb and catatonic, having lost most of themselves to the entity that inhabited them. More sinister exorcists will perform this procedure on purpose, placing powerful entities into a patient, only to remove it and render the patient hollow and willing to become a subject to the apothecary.

fluffInfo.name: Mutagenist
fluffInfo.value: The failed experiments of a Mutagenist can leave all manner of strange disfigurations and abnormalities upon their patients. Everything from unusual growths, cankers, and tumors, to fully growing extra limbs, eyes, mouths, and other such strange occurrences. These patients become hideous mockeries of their former selves and over time, become reliant on the doctor to keep their growths and mutations in check.

fluffInfo.name: Pathogenist
fluffInfo.value: When sick with disease, or dealing with unknown poisons, subjects will go to a Pathogenist. Those who take their practices too far often use subjects as vessels for experimentation. Subjects are often riddled with diseases, sores, boils, at times losing their teeth and fingernails to unnatural decay, their skin turning shades of yellow, green, or purple. They appear sickly, carrying a many pathogens, toxins, and diseases.

fluffInfo.name: Reanimator
fluffInfo.value: Reanimators are sought out when a patient has lost a limb, or had severe injury that would leave them scarred or disfigured. The Reanimators who take their practice too far will use the subject as a means of experimentation. Attaching new limbs to them, testing the lengths they can go by adding multiple limbs, or a second head, additional fingers or toes, subjects over time can become a patchwork of various parts that have been removed, reattached, or swapped.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Medicine* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks to Study a Wretched Patient, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Broken by Experimentation
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's Conditioned Obedience trait.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Fervent Loyalty
fluffInfo.value: You know these creatures protect their creator via their Protective Impulse Reaction.

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: Wretched Patients are simple minions. They defend themselves and reluctantly fight at the command of their creator. If their creator dies, Wretched Patients flee or cower.

traits.name: Conditioned Obedience
traits.value: While the patient can see its creator, it has Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

actions.name: Rusty Surgical Blade
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (**1d8 + 3**) Slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Poison damage.

fluffInfo.value: *As the ichor drips away and the smoke clears, you see a monstrous creature standing 15 feet tall, a canine, fanged head with two jagged horns protruding from its crown.*

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.value: If Xarashtar dies outside the Abyss, his body dissolves into ichor, and he gains a new body instantly, reviving with all of his Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.value: Xarashtar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: Xarashtar makes two Pincer attacks and uses Pummel or Spellcasting.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 16 (**2d10 + 5**) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) from one of two pincers.

actions.name: Pummel
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, one creature Grappled by Xarashtar. *Failure:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) Bludgeoning damage. *Success* Half damage.

traits.name: Fully Contaminated
traits.value: The dragon is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. The dragon may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

traits.name: Delerium Healing
traits.value: As an action, the dragon can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once the dragon has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

traits.name: Alien Intellect
traits.value: The dragon is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (*Insight*) checks made to ascertain the dragon's intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.

traits.name: Haze Aura
traits.value: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the dragon takes 10 (**3d6**) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: The dragon always takes its turn on Initiative count 20
actions.value: On its turn, the dragon can use its movement and interaction as normal. However, it does not take an action or Bonus Action on its turn unless forced to do so by a spell or other effect. Instead, the dragon takes one of the following Epic Actions at the end of each player character's turn:

entries: **Bite**: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 17 (**2d10 + 6**) Force damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 18). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.
**Contaminated Rend**: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18, one creature within 5 feet of the dragon. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level.

**Tail**: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 18, one creature within 20 feet of the dragon. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Force damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Octarine Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.value: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 14 (**4d6**) Necrotic damage plus 14 (**4d6**) Psychic damage plus 14 (**4d6**) Radiant damage. *Success* Half damage.

actions.name: Dimension Hop (1/Round)
actions.value: The dragon teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

actions.name: Epic Resistance
actions.value: The dragon chooses one condition, spell, or other effect currently affecting them and rolls 1d20. On an 11+, the effect ends on it. The dragon can use this action even if it would otherwise be unable to take actions, its actions are being controlled by another creature, or if a spell or effect alters its game statistics.

traits.name: Unshakeable Faith (1/Day)
traits.value: When the zealot would fail a saving throw, it can reroll the save with Advantage. It must use the new roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The zealot makes two Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d6 + 3**) Slashing damage plus 7 (**2d6**) Radiant damage.

bonusActions.name: For the Flame (1/Day)
bonusActions.value: Allies of the zealot within 60 feet of it that can hear it gain Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of the zealot's next turn.

fluffInfo.name: Study the Foe
fluffInfo.value: Characters proficient in *Arcana* or *Religion* gain Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks when taking the Study action to examine it, learning the following based on the result:

fluffInfo.name: (10+) Angry Undead
fluffInfo.value: You recognize the creature's Morrigan's
Fury bonus action.

fluffInfo.name: (15+) Rejuvenating Violence
fluffInfo.value: You learn of the creature's Blood Shield trait.

fluffInfo.name: (20+) Swift and Strong
fluffInfo.value: You know the creature's highest and lowest ability scores as well as its Vampire Weaknesses

fluffInfo.name: Combat Tactics
fluffInfo.value: As soon as a Zealot of Morrigan gets the scent of combat, they use their Bonus Action to enter Morrigan's Fury, amplifying their damage and bolstering them against assault. With their superior speed, they zone in on the easiest meal within range, assailing them with their claws and fangs. The blood spilt from these attacks then serves as a buffer, fueling their Blood Shield. In their fury, the zealots have no sense of survival or self-preservation, as they fight to the death.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.value: The vampire has Advantage on melee attack rolls against a creature with the *Bloodied* condition.

traits.name: Blood Shield
traits.value: Whenever the vampire damages a creature that has blood, the vampire gains 15 Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.value: The vampire regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes Radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.value: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.value: The vampire has the traits described in the "Vampire Weaknesses" sidebar in the Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.value: The vampire makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Bite.

actions.name: Claws
actions.value: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (**2d4 + 5**) Slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 21).

actions.name: Bite
actions.value: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. *Failure:* 15 (**3d6 + 5**) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point Maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains Hit Points equal to that amount.

bonusActions.name: Morrigan's Fury (1/Short Rest)
bonusActions.value: The vampire howls at the moon, gaining Resistance to all damage except Acid and Radiant damage for 1 minute or until it has the Incapacitated condition. As part of this Bonus Action, the vampire moves up to half its Speed toward a Hostile creature without provoking Opportunity Attack action.
